jobs.title: Founding Engineer
jobs.description: About 3Y Health 3Y Health is building the operating system for healthcare practices, an AI-native platform that helps clinicians start, run and grow their practice. We work as a managed services organization (MSO): along with the software, our operations team runs the back office for the clinics we partner with, including billing, insurance and compliance. We currently serve applied behavior analysis (ABA) therapy practices and are expanding into speech, occupational and physical therapy, and psychiatry. About the role Members of Technical Staff own features end to end. You'll work with the clinicians and operators who use what we build, scope the problem, design and build the solution across the stack, deploy it and follow how it performs in production. Our engineering team is flat, with no sub-teams, so you'll work across the whole platform. We build with AI coding agents every day and expect you to do the same. What you'll do Design and build AI agents and automated workflows for clinic operations, such as insurance benefits verification, prior authorizations, patient intake, claims and clinical documentation Build features for clinicians, patients and families, and our internal operations team, on web and mobile Take ambiguous problems from 0 to 1, working with operators and clinicians to define the problem, write the spec and ship a first version Design the services, data models and APIs behind your features and manage the infrastructure as code Own your services in production: deployments, monitoring and incident response Write evals for model-facing features and track the metrics of the workflows you ship Work with protected health information (PHI) safely, with least-privilege access, no PHI in logs and auditable changes Build and maintain the skills, plugins, MCP integrations and review bots our engineers use with Claude Code and Codex Our stack Backend: Python (our primary language for new services), Kotlin with Hasura (GraphQL) on our established platform, plus TypeScript (NestJS) and some Go Frontend and mobile: React, Next.js, React Native Data: PostgreSQL (including pgvector), Snowflake Workflows and contracts: Temporal, gRPC/Protobuf Infrastructure: AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS), Terraform, GitHub Actions, Datadog, LaunchDarkly AI: Claude and OpenAI models, Claude Code and Codex, with our own skills, plugins, MCP integrations and an AI code-review bot Must-haves 5+ years of experience building and shipping production software Recent, hands-on experience using or building AI harnesses: the layer around a model or coding agent (project instructions, tools and MCP servers, skills, hooks, subagents, evals), not only calls to a model API. You can show what you set up or built. At least one personal project you built and published on the web, live and usable by anyone, ideally a SaaS with payments working (e.g. Stripe). Share the link when you apply. What we're looking for A track record of owning products or features end to end, from an unclear problem to a system people depend on Strong full-stack skills in Python and TypeScript, with experience across frontend, backend, databases and cloud infrastructure Comfort working in a large, established codebase Hands-on experience building with LLMs, including tool use, agent orchestration, structured outputs, retrieval and evals (LangGraph, an agents SDK or similar) Daily use of AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. You know how to set them up for a codebase (project instructions, skills, MCP servers, hooks, subagents), run several tasks in parallel and review their output carefully. If you haven't heard of Claude Code, this role is likely not a fit. Good product sense and the ability to make solid UI decisions without a dedicated designer, using our component library High agency: you unblock yourself, look for context and ask questions when you need to Clear written communication. The team is distributed across time zones and most decisions happen in specs, PRs

jobs.description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity. About the Role The Exploration Company builds the TEC vehicle family and is preparing the next generation of vehicles and products. As a Senior Avionics Engineer in the Future Systems team, you will be the system engineer who turns future mission concepts into credible, well-defined avionics, communications and power architectures. You will bring a solid working expertise in electrical power systems, data handling and communications, and you will shape designs that are ready to be challenged, tested and flown. You will work closely with the other engineering disciplines, and you will report to the Principal Engineer of the project. Key Responsibilities Own work packages or full future projects in avionics, communications and power, from concept through verification, delivering on time, on quality and on cost. Define functional breakdowns and high-level requirements , flow them down to avionics subsystems, and manage the associated technical baselines so the design meets the needs of each project. Develop system architectures and conceptual designs , perform avionics-related technical trade-offs, and carry out budget and performance analyses (power, mass, data, thermal interfaces). Write development, implementation, verification and validation plans , and drive them through to completion with the teams involved. Develop hardware solutions for future projects, from requirements to integration and test support. What we would love to see from you In this role, ideally, you will have the following: Proven hands-on experience in designing electrical systems for spacecraft or other aerospace platforms, with a clear record of delivering them. A broad understanding of the full functional chain of space-based avionics, communications and power systems, and how the pieces interact. Able to work effectively with neighboring subsystems (thermal, GNC, propulsion, flight software, operations), understanding their interfaces and constraints well enough to resolve cross-disciplinary trade-offs and keep interface control documents aligned. Strong systems engineering skills : defining requirements and their flow-down, managing technical baselines, and producing architectures and trade-offs. Experience with budgets and performance analysis (power, mass, data, thermal) to support design decisions. Hands-on experience with development, assembly, integration and testing of electrical units for space applications. Strong written and oral communication skills in English , with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to engineers, managers and partners. Offene Unternehmenskultur: Regelmäßige Team-Events, ob du aus unserem Berliner Office oder remote aus Deutschland arbeitest. Moderne Arbeitsausstattung für dein mobiles Arbeiten. Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg: Mit Stock Options wirst du Teil unseres Erfolgs. jobs.description: <h1>Growth at CFO Insights</h1> <p>Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.</p> <p>The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.</p> <p>You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.</p> <p>If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.</p> <h2><strong>Why CFO Insights</strong></h2> <p>CFO Insights is Northern Europe’s largest CFO forum and aims to connect and develop CFOs, finance leaders, and tomorrow's innovators by addressing the issues of the future CFO. We are connecting more than 11,000 professionals from more than 15 countries.</p> <p>CFO Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.</p> <h2><strong>What we offer you</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Master the highest bar in the world.</strong> Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.</li> <li><strong>Unlimited growth potential. </strong>You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.</li> <li><strong>Skills that compound for life.</strong> Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.</li> <li><strong>Ownership from the very start.</strong> You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.</li> <li><strong>Travel opportunity.</strong> You will be joining our 10+ conferences.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you will do</strong></h2> <p>Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Build the audience.</strong> Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.</li> <li><strong>Own marketing channels that drive revenue. </strong>Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue</li> <li><strong>Write copy that persuades.</strong> Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.</li> <li><strong>Sprint, test, implement.</strong> Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.</li> <li><strong>Build systems, not one-offs.</strong> Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.</li> <li><strong>Do whatever it takes to win.</strong> Some days

jobs.title: Director of Product Marketing, Governance
jobs.description: <p><strong>Hybrid role (3 days in the office, 2 days remote), based in our London office at HYLO, 103–105 Bunhill Row, London EC1Y 8LZ.</strong></p> <p>At JFrog, we’re reinventing the Software Supply Chain to help the world’s greatest companies innovate -- and we want you along for the ride. This is a special place with a unique combination of brilliance, spirit, and just all-around great people. Here, if you’re willing to do more, your career can take off. And since software plays a central role in everyone’s lives, you’ll be part of an important mission. Thousands of customers, including the majority of the Fortune 100, trust JFrog to manage, accelerate, and secure their software delivery from code to production -- a concept we call “liquid software.” Wouldn't it be amazing if you could join us in our journey?</p> <p>We are looking for a visionary, strategic, and highly experienced Director of Product Marketing, Governance to join our Product Marketing leadership team. In this role, you will take full ownership of the go-to-market strategy, category creation, and global expansion for our GRC portfolio, JFrog AppTrust. By establishing JFrog as the de facto standard in "DevGovOps" and software supply chain governance, you will bridge the gap between rigid compliance requirements, security needs, and high-velocity engineering. Your deep understanding of application security, governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) will translate complex regulatory frameworks into market-defining narratives. jobs.title: Marketing Automation Engineer
jobs.description: <h1>Growth at HRtechX</h1> <p>Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.</p> <p>The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.</p> <p>You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.</p> <p>If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.</p> <h2><strong>Why HRtechX</strong></h2> <p>HRtechX is a world leading HRtech community, connecting industry executives, entrepreneurs and professionals. We are a start-up on a growth journey who help leaders evolve and create stronger businesses through people and technology. We aim to address the challenges and opportunities for HR and HR Tech. We bring together the most influential executives, investors, and entrepreneurs to share their insights on how technology will shape the future of HR, as well as forge long lasting partnerships and client relationships.</p> <p>HRtechX is part of United Media (<a href="https://www.united-media.com/">https://www.united-media.com/</a>) which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc.</p> <h2><strong>What we offer you</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Master the highest bar in the world.</strong> Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.</li> <li><strong>Unlimited growth potential. </strong>You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.</li> <li><strong>Skills that compound for life.</strong> Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.</li> <li><strong>Ownership from the very start.</strong> You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.</li> <li><strong>Travel opportunity.</strong> You will be joining our 10+ conferences.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you will do</strong></h2> <p>Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Build the audience.</strong> Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.</li> <li><strong>Own marketing channels that drive revenue. </strong>Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue</li> <li><strong>Write copy that persuades.</strong> Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.</li> <li><strong>Sprint, test, implement.</strong> Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.</li

jobs.title: Service Desk Analyst
jobs.description: What is the job? This is not your usual service desk job. You'll be the person our clinicians, pharmacists and office teams think of when they think of IT and, one of a very small team that makes technology work across a regulated, growing healthcare business. Some days that means sorting a laptop for a new starter. Others it means getting a prescription printer back online before the afternoon dispatch, helping open a new office, or working out why a process keeps breaking and fixing it for good. We're a scale-up that still feels like a start-up: things move fast, priorities shift, and there's rarely a playbook. We want someone who finds that energising, not exhausting. This role will suit a self-starter who wants to make a positive difference. We care as much about how you work with people, how you think and how you own things than about the certificates on your CV. What will you be doing? Be the face of IT. Look after people across our offices and remote teams, in person and within the dedicated slack channel. Fix things, explain things, and leave people more confident than you found them. Keep the pharmacy running. Own the reliability of the printers, scanners and devices behind prescription dispensing, where downtime directly delays patients' medicines. Run identity and access well. Manage joiners, movers and leavers across Google Workspace and Microsoft Entra ID, carefully and on time, because in a regulated business access matters. Look after devices. Set up, secure, track and retire laptops and phones, and help shape how we manage them as we grow. Help build what's next. Get hands-on with new office fit-outs, network and security projects, supplier rollouts and tooling changes. Fix root causes, not just tickets. Spot patterns, propose improvements and see them through, from automating a dull task to rewriting a confusing process. Write it down. Keep guides, runbooks and asset records clear enough that someone else could pick them up tomorrow, and good enough for an auditor. What do you need? Behaviours People trust you. You can calm a stressed pharmacist, explain a technical problem to a director without jargon, and push back politely when something isn't safe. You own things. When you pick something up, people stop worrying about it. You follow through, and you say early when something is slipping. You're curious. You want to know why something broke, not just how to make the error go away. You learn new tools quickly and enjoy it. You're careful. You can move fast and still respect change control, data protection and access rules. You know when not to improvise. You're comfortable with ambiguity. You can make sensible calls with incomplete information, and you'll ask when you need to. You make things better. You notice friction others have stopped seeing, and you suggest and deliver fixes without waiting to be asked. Experience Hands-on experience supporting people in a busy IT role, wherever you gained it Confidence troubleshooting macOS and Windows, phones, printers and peripherals Experience administering cloud tools, ideally Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365 and Entra ID A working grasp of networking basics: Wi-Fi, DNS, DHCP, VPNs Comfort at a command line, and enough scripting to automate a repetitive task Good written English for clear documentation It would be great, but not essential, if you've also worked with: Device management (MDM) for Mac, Windows or mobile Healthcare, pharmacy or another regulated environment Zero-trust networking (e.g. Tailscale), AWS, or infrastructure as code Office moves, network installs or physical security systems What we offer: Generous Leave : 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three) + usual public holidays Pension Matching : Up to 5% employer matching contributions Flexibility and Wellness : Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, private healthcare and more Growth Opportunities : Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, wi

Conception de la stratégie et de la transformation IA</strong></p> <p>Vous définissez la vision IA et la roadmap priorisée des cas d’usage, challengez la pertinence de l’IA et assumez les arbitrages. Lorsque c’est pertinent, vous conduisez des refontes de processus de bout en bout, en pensant lean avant de déployer l’IA et en mobilisant les équipes Engineering et AI Adoption pour les livrer. Vous concevez le modèle opératoire cible et sécurisez ses conditions de succès.</p> <p><strong>II. Analyses, business cases &amp; prototypage</strong></p> <p>Vous concevez et pilotez les travaux d’analyse de la mission, business cases inclus, afin de sécuriser des décisions fondées sur les données et sur les faits, et vous revoyez le travail de l’équipe. Vous prototypez rapidement des cas d’usage pour illustrer la valeur par la démo et aider les clients à se projeter dans la solution finale.</p> <p><strong>III. Delivery, livrables &amp; collaboration</strong></p> <p>Vous dirigez les missions au quotidien en donnant de la visibilité aux sponsors clients : vous découpez chaque mission en streams, anticipez les risques et challengez le client lorsque c’est pertinent. Vous produisez en autonomie des livrables de niveau C-suite et des synthèses exécutives, structurez la storyline et veillez au respect des standards de qualité Artefact. Vous orchestrez les équipes Engineering pour la faisabilité technique et les équipes AI Adoption pour ancrer l’adoption sur le terrain.</p> <p><strong>IV. jobs.title: Test Development Engineer
jobs.description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity. Here at The Exploration Company, we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refuelled in orbit, and which carries cargo – and potentially humans in the long run. We are also developing different types of propulsion systems to power our future vehicles and missions. As a talented Test Development Engineer , you will be part of the team that is responsible for the development of test facilities for our future propulsion systems. Key Responsibilities / Tasks: In your capacity as a Test Development Engineer , your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties may include: Synthesise test bench requirements from user and operator needs and plan required verification methods and tests. Translate engine test objectives and stakeholder needs into facility-level functional and performance requirements. Perform technical trade-offs to determine the best choice of hardware, software, equipment, component, location etc for various test facilities. Perform risk assessment analyses for future tests and developing mitigation actions to ensure personnel and hardware safety. Provide technical inputs to cost, schedule, procurement, commissioning, maintainability, and facility acceptance planning. Prepare and maintain P&IDs of test facilities based on test bench requirements and selecting components. Undertaking preliminary design of the ground support equipment with minimal oversight. Undertake hazard assessments of the test facility design (FMEA and HAZOPs) to determine if any additional changes to the design are required. Work with the current test bench team to coordinate end-to-end activities of the development of test facilities including design, reviews, manufacturing, installation, commissioning, test operations, ongoing upgrades and maintenance. Work with procurement, AIT and design teams during the development of test facilities to find the right balance of technical solutions, cost and lead time. Presenting findings to team members and participating in design reviews and project discussions. What we would love to see from you: Bachelor's, master's or PhD in aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related field (Master’s and above preferred). 2–5 years of experience in propulsion, test facility development, experimental engineering, or a related field. Practical experience in the design, development, commissioning, or operation of test facilities, preferably for rocket propulsion systems. Experience in test facility design for cryogenic propulsion systems is highly desirable. Relevant experience with other cryogenic or high-pressure fluid systems will also be considered. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret technical data, challenge assumptions, and make evidence-based engineering recommendations. Proven ability to work autonomously on assigned technical topics while contributing effectively to a multidisciplinary engineering team. Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts to diverse audiences. Why you should join us! What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is: We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge? We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. jobs.title: Stage M2 : Optimisation de l’implantation de l’offre de soins en zones rurales
jobs.description: Optimisation de l’implantation de l’offre de soins en zones rurales Organisme d’accueil : Centre de Génie Industriel (CGI) – IMT Mines Albi Le Centre de Génie Industriel (CGI) développe des activités d’enseignement et de recherche autour de la modélisation, du pilotage et de l’amélioration des systèmes industriels et organisationnels, dans des contextes complexes et incertains (industrie du futur, supply chain, résilience, etc.). Contexte et missions Les inégalités territoriales d’accès aux soins constituent un enjeu majeur des politiques publiques de santé en France. Elles sont particulièrement marquées dans les territoires ruraux et isolés, caractérisés par une faible densité de population, des distances importantes aux services de santé et une démographie médicale parfois fragile. Dans ces territoires, l’amélioration de l’accès aux soins ne repose pas uniquement sur l’augmentation du nombre de professionnels de santé, mais également sur leur localisation et leur organisation territoriale. Dans le cadre du projet de recherche MAillage Territorial pour Améliorer l’Accès aux soins dans les zones Rurales et Isolées (MATAARI), l’objectif est de développer des méthodes d’optimisation permettant de concevoir de nouvelles organisations territoriales de l’offre de soins, en tenant compte des contraintes géographiques, démographiques et médicales. Les indicateurs actuellement utilisés pour caractériser l’accès aux soins, notamment l’Accessibilité Potentielle Localisée (APL) développée par la DREES [1], permettent de prendre en compte simultanément la demande de soins, l’offre médicale et la distance entre les populations et les professionnels de santé. Aujourd’hui, ces indicateurs sont principalement utilisés à des fins de diagnostic et de caractérisation des territoires. L’enjeu de ce stage sera de les intégrer dans un problème d’optimisation afin de déterminer les conditions nécessaires à l’amélioration de l’accessibilité aux soins. Le stage constituera ainsi une première étape consacrée à la localisation optimale de professionnels de santé, avant une intégration ultérieure de ce problème dans les modèles de districting développés dans le cadre de MATAARI. Dans un premier temps, le.la candidat.e développera un modèle de Facility Location Problem (FLP) intégrant notamment l’offre et la demande de soins, les indicateurs d’accessibilité, les spécificités territoriales et sociales, qui pourront être éclairées par les travaux de l’équipe interdisciplinaire en sciences humaines et sociales travaillant également sur le projet. Une attention particulière sera portée à la non-linéarité du problème. Dans un second temps, le modèle de localisation sera adapté dans une perspective d’intégration au problème de districting territorial développé dans le projet MATAARI. Il s’agira d'identifier comment les décisions de localisation de l’offre médicale peuvent être intégrées aux décisions de découpage du territoire afin de construire un modèle hiérarchisé ou intégré. L’objectif final est ainsi de disposer d’un modèle de localisation autonome pouvant constituer un module d’optimisation de l’offre de soins, intégrable ultérieurement aux modèles de maillage territorial développés par les autres acteurs du projet. État de l’art Les problèmes de localisation d’infrastructures (Facility Location Problems) constituent une famille classique de problèmes de recherche opérationnelle visant à déterminer l’implantation optimale d’un ensemble d’infrastructures afin de répondre à une demande distribuée spatialement [2], [3] De nombreuses variantes ont été développées, notamment les problèmes de p-median, set covering, maximal covering location problem et capacitated facility location. Ces modèles ont été largement mobilisés dans le domaine de la santé pour étudier l’implantation d’hôpitaux, de centres de soins ou de professionnels de santé [4], [5] Dans le contexte médical, les modèles de localisation doivent toutefois intégrer des caractéristiques spécifiques :

jobs.title: Machine Learning & AI Internship
jobs.description: WHY this position is important Pennylane builds the financial management and accounting platform used by SMEs and accounting firms in France, Germany and Spain. As a product-led company, we invest first in the product, and AI is now at the core of it. The ML & AI team (about thirty people in Paris, part of the Data organisation) builds the AI inside the product. Its first priority is Autopilot : automated accounting production with the accountant in control. Autopilot reads documents, books entries, matches bank transactions, reviews client files and prepares VAT returns with as little human intervention as possible. These tasks raise real ML problems. Answers must be exact, every client is different, accounting constraints can be checked automatically, and we have millions of real examples corrected by accountants. This internship is a chance to work on one of these problems with real data, real users and a direct path to production. HOW you will contribute You will join the ML & AI team, within a Tech organisation of more than 400 people. You will work on one main topic for the whole internship, protected from day-to-day work, with a dedicated tutor. Every topic follows the same path: Evaluation first : in the first weeks, you agree with your tutor on a frozen evaluation set and the metrics that matter. A baseline in production : you ship a simpler first version that the team can put into production, around months 1 to 3. Then go further : you improve it and explore more advanced approaches. Research topics are designed to lead to a publishable result. You will own the topic end to end: understanding the problem with accountants and product teams, defining success metrics, building, measuring and presenting your results. Topics for 2027 Here is an overview of the topics we want to staff in 2027. We agree on the final topic and your tutor with you. Reading invoices and new types of documents with compact vision-language models (VLMs): fine-tuning, supervision from e-invoices, reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. Knowing when the AI is right : calibrated confidence, selective automation and model routing for automated accounting decisions. Evaluating accounting agents : an open benchmark of long-horizon accounting tasks on simulated client files, with verifiable scoring. Learning from accountants' corrections : turning feedback into editable rules, with non-regression guarantees. Bank reconciliation : matching one transaction to several documents, as learned graph optimisation. An AI agent for Autopilot support tickets : from investigation to a pull request. This is an applied topic for profiles who prefer building systems close to production. Data foundations for AI : evaluation datasets, data quality and monitoring, and agents that let teams query and use data on their own. AI will be part of how you work You will use coding assistants and AI agents every day: to explore the codebase and data models, write Python and SQL, run experiments, write tests and debug. We expect you to give agents the right context and to check their output. You own the result, not the agent. OUR CULTURE You will join a hands-on engineering culture, where two technical co-founders are still among the most active contributors to the codebase. You will work with ML and AI engineers, data specialists, software engineers, product managers and accountants. You will have strong mentorship and a lot of ownership: freedom to test ideas, challenge existing approaches and build things from scratch, with an R&D mindset. The goal is not a demo. It is something the team can trust, reuse and ship. YOU'RE THE RIGHT CANDIDATE IF YOU Are in the final year of a Master's degree or engineering school in machine learning, computer science, statistics or applied mathematics. Research internships of at least 4 months are also considered. Have strong ML foundations and solid Python, and have already trained, fine-tuned or evaluated models in academic

Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. About the role As a Flight Control Intern, you explore how far an aircraft can be pushed beyond natural stability, and what performance that buys. Instability makes aircraft more agile, but only if the control system can keep them flying. You own your project end to end: you choose and build unstable airframes, identify their dynamics from flight data, design the control that stabilizes them, and measure the limits of what can be achieved. You work on agile, high-performance platforms in a fast-paced engineering team with an industrial, production-first mindset, flying frequently on a dedicated test range. You are a full member of the team, with visibility on how the company and its products evolve and a direct impact on what we ship. Responsibilities Select and justify unstable configurations to study, such as multirotor and VTOL (vertical take-off and landing), relaxed-stability fixed wings, and tailless, blended-wing or canard layouts. Design and build the airframes yourself (foam, 3D printing, composites), integrate the avionics provided by the team, and repair after crashes. Plan and run flight test campaigns with excitation maneuvers, and iterate quickly on a dedicated test range. Identify the aircraft dynamics from flight data (system identification) and validate the models against analytical and simulated results. Design and tune stabilizing controllers on PX4 or ArduPilot, then port them to Harmattan's in-house flight controller firmware. Push the instability step by step, for example by moving the center of gravity aft or reducing control surfaces, and analyze stability margins. jobs.description: Who We Are AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to specifying, orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint. We are at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, a toolchain observability and intelligence platform used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – with support for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, npm, Python, and Bazel. We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. Develocity encodes a decade of build and test expertise into a context engineering layer: the ground truth AI agents need to change code safely, and the governance to attribute and gate that change at machine speed. Trust, evidence, and explainability are at the core of everything we build. We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community. Our Values Seek to Understand: Everything starts with listening and understanding, and we strive to understand different viewpoints, problems, and motivations. Before we take action, we ensure we truly grasp the challenges, perspectives, and goals.  Know the Why: We approach our work with a clear sense of purpose, ensuring every step is deliberate and focused. We take meaningful action with urgency, but never at the expense of thoughtful consideration.  Innovate & Iterate: We embrace challenges and are not afraid to try new things, even if they might fail. With deep understanding and a clear purpose, we can develop creative and bold solutions to tackle challenges. Own the Outcome: We are empowered to take initiative and we maintain transparency in our work and its outcomes. When we execute, we take responsibility for our decisions, measure the success of our innovations, and learn from the results. You enjoy the pace of a growing company, stay close to what your teams are building, and help the people around you take on more ownership. Our ideal candidates are passionate about building products that help engineering teams ship better software, faster. They follow closely how AI is changing the way software gets built, and they want to help Develocity lead that change. jobs.title: Head of Hardware
jobs.description: Accelerating embodied AGI. The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century. microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data. We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries. Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Head of Hardware, you own that hardware end to end: electrical, firmware, and the mechanical integration that holds it together, from the first schematic to devices running on factory floors. You lead the team that builds it. Today that is about six engineers on robotics, three on EMG sensing, and three on camera systems, plus contractors, and it will grow quickly. Our Electrical Engineer and Embedded Engineer roles report to you. You set the architecture they build against, and you still build alongside them. This is a founder-shaped role, not a management seat. We are looking for someone who has carried a product from a blank page to customers with real skin in the game, wants to build both the thing and the team that builds it, and would rather design than review. If that sounds like you, you will want to do it again at the earliest stage. What You Will Do Own the hardware roadmap for Shift and Atlas data capture: wearables, sensor rigs, camera systems, and prototype robots. What we build, in what order, and why. Set the system architecture across electrical, firmware, and mechanical: sensors, compute, power, wireless, and enclosures. Make the trade-offs, and make them stick when disciplines disagree. Stay on the bench: schematics, layout reviews, board bring-up, and a scope in your hands when the team is stuck. On the days it matters, you are the best electrical engineer in the room. Lead and grow the team: hire, set the bar, run design reviews, and give engineers ownership of whole subsystems rather than tickets. Guarantee data quality end to end: EMG and EEG front ends, camera pipelines, IMUs, and synchronization across many devices, so that what reaches the ML team is clean, time-aligned, and trustworthy. Take designs from prototype to small-batch production: DFM, component and EMS vendors, test fixtures, certification, and field reliability. Work shoulder to shoulder with ML and deployment. Your hardware decides what the training data looks like, and you will be on the floor where it is captured. Run contractors and partners without losing ownership of the result. Requirements You have taken at least one product from zero to shipped, with significant ownership of the outcome: as a co-founder, CTO, first hardware hire, or the lead who owned the whole device. Not one subsystem, not one phase. Ideally a wearable, at a tier-one hardware company known for shipping at scale. Electrical engineering is your home discipline. You have designed boards that shipped, across mixed-signal, power, wireless, and high-speed digital, and you can still do it today. You think in systems. You understand how an electrode choice, an enclosure tolerance, and an ADC sample rate interact, and you can hold the mechanical and firmware conversations as a peer, not a customer. jobs.description: We are looking for a seasoned Senior Security Engineer, focused on AI & Application Security, to join our Platform team in Amsterdam. Working in a bootstrapped and profitable scaleup, you'll take a proactive, hands-on, senior role securing our agentic AI products, owning an emerging and fast-growing area of security engineering, the risks that come specifically from building with LLMs and autonomous agents, while helping raise the bar on our broader application security practices. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it. And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers . Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast. If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way. What You Will Do Own AI-specific security as a discipline at DataSnipper: identify, assess, and mitigate the risks unique to LLM-based and agentic systems across our products and platform. Translate security policies and risk requirements into concrete technical controls, standards, and guardrails, in partnership with Legal and technical teams. Build a proactive AI security practice grounded in frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, the broader OWASP GenAI Security Project (including agentic security), MITRE ATLAS, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and adapt them to how we build. Threat model our agentic features and pipelines, covering prompt injection, sensitive information disclosure, data and model poisoning, insecure output handling, excessive agency, supply-chain risk, and unsafe tool and API use. Red team our AI systems, probing models, prompts, agents, and integrations for weaknesses before attackers do, and turn findings into concrete fixes and guardrails. Design and help implement guardrails, input/output validation, sandboxing, least-privilege tool access, and monitoring for AI and agent behavior. Embed security into how we build AI, shifting security left through secure-by-design guidance, secure SDLC practices, and design and code reviews for AI features. Partner with product and engineering teams to make secure AI the default, providing patterns, tooling, and guidance rather than after-the-fact gatekeeping. We are a remote-first team of product, engineering, design and QA who work closely with Operations, Customer Support, Sales and Supplier Experience. We are low on hierarchy and high on ownership, and we like solving problems where software meets the physical world. About the Role As our Senior Product Manager for Fulfilment & Express, you will own how Nivoda orders get from supplier to jeweller: accurately promised, reliably tracked and delivered fast. jobs.description: Legal AI is zo goed als de kennis erachter, en aan die kennis bouwen we bij Lefebvre Sdu al 200 jaar. Dag in, dag uit. Wet voor wet. Woord voor woord. Dat doen we zo zorgvuldig dat andere legal AI-tools op onze data en software draaien. Vanuit ons Nederlandse kantoor bouwen we daarnaast voor Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider in juridische en fiscale kennis, ons eigen platform: GenIA-L, dat in Europa inmiddels goed is voor meer dan 100 miljoen euro ARR. Ruim 75.000 professionals werken er dagelijks mee, en we bouwen het op de standaard die hun vak vraagt. We zoeken een Senior DevOps Engineer die zorgt dat alles wat we bouwen veilig en soepel live gaat. HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT GenIA-L schuift steeds verder het dagelijkse werk van juristen en fiscalisten in, en dat vraagt om een platform dat soepel meebeweegt. Onze developers willen snel bouwen en veilig live gaan, zonder uren kwijt te zijn aan pipelines en repository-setup. Daar zorg jij voor. Onze infrastructuur draait op AWS, met Kubernetes via EKS, Terraform en Helm, en onze CI/CD loopt via GitHub Actions. Je weet dat het gelukt is als de andere teams merkbaar minder tijd kwijt zijn aan hun deployments, de infrastructuur gezond is en je precies ziet wat er gebeurt. Wat nu nog ontbreekt, is het team dat dit zelf gaat dragen, en dat bouw jij mee op. DIT ZOEKEN WIJ Je bent een DevOps engineer die het liefst dicht bij de developers zit. Je bouwt een platform waar anderen zelf mee verder kunnen, vindt het vanzelfsprekend dat security in elke pipeline is ingebouwd en brengt graag rust en overzicht in een omgeving die in beweging is. Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar hands-on ervaring met Kubernetes, idealiter met AWS EKS. Je hebt veel gewerkt met AWS en Infrastructure as Code. CI/CD en containers zijn een vertrouwd onderdeel van je werk. Je zorgt voor duidelijkheid in technische processen en afspraken. Ervaring met het bouwen en doorontwikkelen van een softwareproduct is een pré. Je krijgt veel vertrouwen, eigenaarschap en vrijheid, dus zie je iets wat beter moet, dan pak je het hier meestal gewoon zelf op. Daarbij is er ruimte voor een goede balans tussen werk en privé. Daarom zoeken we een creatieve en zelfstandige stagiair die ons helpt om onze producten, software en toepassingen op een moderne en aantrekkelijke manier in beeld te brengen. jobs.title: Quality Manager (all genders) – Quality & Sustainability
jobs.description: Deine Aufgaben Du bist Teil des Produktteams und verantwortest den gesamten Qualitätsbereich sowie die Einhaltung relevanter Qualitäts- und Futtermittelstandards bei mammaly. Du stehst im engen Austausch mit unseren Lieferanten, führst regelmäßige Audits durch und begleitest wichtige Produktionen vor Ort. Du analysierst regelmäßig Kundenreklamationen und überprüfst unseren Warenbestand, um mögliche Qualitätsprobleme frühzeitig zu identifizieren. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Teams im Lager und an den Produktionsstandorten zusammen. Dazu gehören auch regelmäßige Dienstreisen für Vor-Ort-Besprechungen und Abstimmungen mit unseren Partnern. Du führst detaillierte Ursachenanalysen und Untersuchungen durch und leitest geeignete Korrektur- und Präventionsmaßnahmen (CAPA) ein. Du leitest Qualitätsinitiativen abteilungsübergreifend und stellst sicher, dass diese gemeinsam mit internen und externen Stakeholdern umgesetzt werden. Du verantwortest den weiteren Aufbau unserer internen Qualitätssicherung und des Qualitätsmanagements. Dazu gehören die Implementierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Qualitätssystemen, Dokumentenmanagement, SOPs, Formularen und Richtlinien. Du unterstützt uns bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Nachhaltigkeitsstandards und ESG-Themen, insbesondere im Zusammenhang mit Lieferanten, Verpackungen und verantwortungsvollen Beschaffungsprozessen. Du koordinierst qualitäts- und nachhaltigkeitsbezogene Anforderungen im Rahmen von B Corp und weiteren relevanten Standards und unterstützt die entsprechende Dokumentation und Umsetzung im Unternehmen. Dein Profil Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Lebensmitteltechnologie, Lebensmittelchemie, Lebensmittelverfahrenstechnik, Verfahrenstechnik, Chemieingenieurwesen oder einer vergleichbaren naturwissenschaftlich-technischen Fachrichtung. Du bringst 3+ Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Lebensmittel-, Tiernahrungs-, Supplement- oder Functional-Food-Industrie mit – idealerweise in der Produktentwicklung, R&D, Lebensmitteltechnologie oder im Quality Management. Du hast praktische Erfahrung in der industriellen Herstellung und bereits Produktionsversuche, Bemusterungen oder Prozessoptimierungen direkt an der Linie oder gemeinsam mit Produktionspartnern begleitet. Du verfügst über fundierte Erfahrung in Qualitätssicherung und Qualitätskontrolle, idealerweise einschließlich Laboranalytik, Reklamationsbearbeitung, CAPA und Freigabeprozessen. Du bringst gute Kenntnisse der relevanten regulatorischen Anforderungen im Lebensmittel- oder Futtermittelrecht mit. Idealerweise hast du bereits erste Berührungspunkte mit Nachhaltigkeits- und ESG-Themen, beispielsweise im Bereich nachhaltiger Verpackungen, Lieferantenstandards, verantwortungsvoller Beschaffung oder Zertifizierungen wie B Corp. Du hast eine hohe Reisebereitschaft und bist flexibel, bei Bedarf auch kurzfristig für Vor-Ort-Termine bei unseren Partnern verfügbar zu sein. Du arbeitest analytisch, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert, übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und hast Freude daran, Prozesse eigenständig aufzubauen und weiterzuentwickeln. Du bist offen für den Einsatz neuer Technologien und KI-gestützter Tools, um Prozesse effizienter zu gestalten und wiederkehrende Aufgaben zu automatisieren. jobs.description: Hallo! Schön, dass du vorbeischaust 👋 Bist du aktiv auf der Suche nach einer neuen Herausforderung? Oder schaust du dich einfach nur auf dem Markt um? Nun… dann bist du hier vielleicht genau richtig! Wir suchen eine/n Head of Field Sales für unser Hospitality-Team vor Ort in München . In dieser Rolle übernehmst du eine Schlüsselfunktion: Du wirst ein komplett neues Team von ca. 8 bis 10 Outbound Field Account Executives aufbauen, strukturieren und leiten. Gemeinsam helft ihr Gastronomen dabei, ihre Abläufe durch modernste Restaurant-Technologie (SaaS POS) zu vereinfachen und zu skalieren. Wir suchen eine vertriebsstarke Führungspersönlichkeit mit nachweisbarem Erfolg im B2B-Sales-Management und der Neukundengewinnung. Deine Aufgaben Teamaufbau & -leitung: Du rekrutierst, führst und coachst ein neues Field-basiertes Team, um die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Fähigkeiten und die Einhaltung von Best Practices zu fördern. Sales Cycle Management: Steuerung des gesamten Vertriebsprozesses – von der Prospektion bis zum Abschluss – bei gleichzeitiger Sicherstellung der täglichen Aktivitäten und der Zielerreichung des Teams. Pipeline & Forecasting: Kompetente Nutzung von Salesforce zur Sicherstellung der Datenintegrität und für präzise wöchentliche Umsatzprognosen an das Management. Hands-on Coaching: Regelmäßige Begleitung deines Teams im Field durch gemeinsame Kundenbesuche, Live-Demos vor Ort und maßgeschneiderte Ansprachestrategien. Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Enge Kooperation mit den Abteilungen Produkt, Implementierung und Account Management, um ein nahtloses Kundenerlebnis zu gewährleisten. Strategisches Wachstum: Entwicklung und Umsetzung strategischer Pläne für das Vertriebsgebiet sowie Identifizierung von Engpässen zur Optimierung der Teameffizienz. Umsatzverantwortung: Erreichen und Übertreffen der gesetzten Neugeschäfts- und Umsatzziele für dein Team und die Region. Was sonst noch dazugehört... Als Teil des erweiterten Teams trägst du maßgeblich zu unseren übergeordneten Unternehmenszielen bei. Das bedeutet auch, dass du mal dort anpackst, wo es brennt – selbst wenn es nicht strikt in deinen Aufgabenbereich fällt (echter Teamgeist eben!). Das bringst du mit Must-Have (Führungserfahrung): Fundierte, nachweisbare Erfahrung im People Management – insbesondere im Aufbau, der Führung und dem Coaching von Field-basierten Vertriebsteams. Must-Have (Field Sales): Tiefgehende Erfahrung im Field Sales und Outbound-Vertrieb sowie eine echte Leidenschaft dafür, gemeinsam mit deinem Team direkt beim Kunden vor Ort zu sein. Arbeitsort: Du wohnst im Raum München oder bist bereit, komplett vor Ort in München zu arbeiten. Sales-Expertise: Die Fähigkeit, ein Vertriebsteam durch den gesamten Sales-Cycle zu steuern – von der Kaltakquise bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Tech-Skills: Sicherer Umgang mit Salesforce für detailliertes Reporting und präzises Forecasting. Branchenkenntnis: Vorerfahrung in den Bereichen SaaS, Hospitality, Gastronomie oder Hotellerie ist ein großes Plus. Hunter-Mentalität: Erfahrung und Erfolg im Outbound-Sales, bei Direktansprachen vor Ort („Walk-ins“) und darin, echtes Interesse für eine Plattform zu wecken. Was wir dir bieten: Erlebe die „Lightspeed Experience“… Lightspeed Equity Scheme: Wir sind alle Miteigentümer (Aktienbeteiligungsprogramm). Gehaltspaket: Attraktives Modell aus Fixgehalt und Provision + Firmenwagen Health & Wellness Credit: Bis zu 400 EUR pro Jahr für das Fitnessstudio, Yoga, ein neues Fahrrad oder was auch immer deiner Gesundheit gut tut. jobs.title: Service Desk Analyst
jobs.description: What is the job? This is not your usual service desk job. You'll be the person our clinicians, pharmacists and office teams think of when they think of IT and, one of a very small team that makes technology work across a regulated, growing healthcare business. Some days that means sorting a laptop for a new starter. Others it means getting a prescription printer back online before the afternoon dispatch, helping open a new office, or working out why a process keeps breaking and fixing it for good. We're a scale-up that still feels like a start-up: things move fast, priorities shift, and there's rarely a playbook. We want someone who finds that energising, not exhausting. This role will suit a self-starter who wants to make a positive difference. We care as much about how you work with people, how you think and how you own things than about the certificates on your CV. What will you be doing? Be the face of IT. Look after people across our offices and remote teams, in person and within the dedicated slack channel. Fix things, explain things, and leave people more confident than you found them. Keep the pharmacy running. Own the reliability of the printers, scanners and devices behind prescription dispensing, where downtime directly delays patients' medicines. Run identity and access well. Manage joiners, movers and leavers across Google Workspace and Microsoft Entra ID, carefully and on time, because in a regulated business access matters. Look after devices. Set up, secure, track and retire laptops and phones, and help shape how we manage them as we grow. Help build what's next. Get hands-on with new office fit-outs, network and security projects, supplier rollouts and tooling changes. Fix root causes, not just tickets. Spot patterns, propose improvements and see them through, from automating a dull task to rewriting a confusing process. Write it down. Keep guides, runbooks and asset records clear enough that someone else could pick them up tomorrow, and good enough for an auditor. What do you need? Behaviours People trust you. You can calm a stressed pharmacist, explain a technical problem to a director without jargon, and push back politely when something isn't safe. You own things. When you pick something up, people stop worrying about it. You follow through, and you say early when something is slipping. You're curious. You want to know why something broke, not just how to make the error go away. You learn new tools quickly and enjoy it. You're careful. You can move fast and still respect change control, data protection and access rules. You know when not to improvise. You're comfortable with ambiguity. You can make sensible calls with incomplete information, and you'll ask when you need to. You make things better. You notice friction others have stopped seeing, and you suggest and deliver fixes without waiting to be asked. Experience Hands-on experience supporting people in a busy IT role, wherever you gained it Confidence troubleshooting macOS and Windows, phones, printers and peripherals Experience administering cloud tools, ideally Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365 and Entra ID A working grasp of networking basics: Wi-Fi, DNS, DHCP, VPNs Comfort at a command line, and enough scripting to automate a repetitive task Good written English for clear documentation It would be great, but not essential, if you've also worked with: Device management (MDM) for Mac, Windows or mobile Healthcare, pharmacy or another regulated environment Zero-trust networking (e.g. Tailscale), AWS, or infrastructure as code Office moves, network installs or physical security systems What we offer: Generous Leave : 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three) + usual public holidays Pension Matching : Up to 5% employer matching contributions Flexibility and Wellness : Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, private healthcare and more Growth Opportunities : Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, wi

jobs.title: Dispensing Pharmacist
jobs.description: What is the job? Are you a qualified dispensing pharmacist that thrives when they can combine pace with precision, always keeping patients at the heart of everything you do? As our new Dispensing Pharmacist you will work in a fast-moving, agile environment where accuracy is paramount, flexibility is essential, and no two days are the same. You will be part of a dedicated team that thrives under pressure, adapts quickly, and takes pride in making a genuine difference to patients’ lives You will be responsible for supervising and managing the dispensing of controlled drug prescriptions for medicinal cannabis, ensuring compliance with stringent regulations, and delivering outstanding patient care. This role requires a detail-oriented, self-motivated individual who is committed to excellence in pharmacy operations. What will you be doing? Clinically check prescriptions for Controlled drug prescriptions for medicinal cannabis Ensure timely availability and dispatch of medicines for patients. Comply with all regulatory requirements for ordering, receiving, storing, and dispensing medicines. Maintain accurate records in line with GPhC standards. Provide patient counselling on the safe use of medicines, including specialised equipment. Offer guidance to prescribers to minimise supply disruptions. Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure safe and compliant supply chains. Act as the Responsible Pharmacist, maintaining security and supervising pharmacy staff. Work with multidisciplinary teams to manage safe prescribing practices. Maintain electronic health records and implement regulatory changes. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: At Gigaton, we’re on a mission to cut gigatonnes of carbon emissions from the world’s biggest emitting industries (like cement, steel and glass), by building autonomous AI control and optimisation systems that learn and leverage the physics of manufacturing. Our products run heavy industrial plants more efficiently, more stably, and with lower emissions in real time - laying the foundation for the next industrial revolution. We are a team of scientists, engineers, builders, and operators who love hard problems, have high standards, and want to make change happen in the physical world. We care about deep tech, but we care even more about whether it delivers cost and carbon impact in a live plant, with real people, under real constraints. With Gigaton, you’ll solve really tough problems in places few people ever get close to, and build something that actually helps the planet. Are you up for the challenge? About the role We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Platform team and help us build reliable software for a complex, real-world AI product. The Platform team works across a broad range of problems at Gigaton, from CI/CD for our monorepo and networking and data integration with on-premise plant systems, to hardening our IoT OS image and building customer-facing software around our control systems. The work is currently split across two squads: Enablement, focused on helping engineers move faster. Product, focused on supporting our control software. jobs.description: À propos de N2JSoft N2JSoft est une Fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la gestion des dépenses professionnelles. Fondée en 2015, elle compte aujourd’hui 20 000 clients et 1M utilisateurs dans 98 pays , faisant de N2F l’un des leaders du marché français. N2F simplifie la gestion des frais professionnels : photo des justificatifs, reconnaissance automatique, validation, export comptable, archivage à valeur probante , etc. L’objectif : faire gagner du temps aux entreprises tout en sécurisant leurs processus internes. Après une croissance progressive, l’équipe est passée de 20 personnes en 2021 à 230 aujourd’hui , portée par le succès produit et l’expansion internationale. jobs.title: Architecte Backup et responsable de la Product Unit Backup - FREELANCE
jobs.description: ImaginePartners recherche, pour l’un de ses clients, un opérateur télécom actif dans le domaine du cloud, un ou une Architecte Backup pour structurer et piloter sa Product Unit Backup. Vous définissez l’architecture de sauvegarde et de restauration du cloud privé et pilotez l’équipe de moins de 10 ingénieurs DevOps chargée de la mettre en œuvre. La Product Unit s’appuie sur des solutions open source pour maîtriser les coûts, préserver l’indépendance technologique et répondre aux enjeux de souveraineté des données. Modalités de la mission Contrat — Freelance Démarrage — Immédiat Localisation — Châtillon / Saint-Denis / Rennes Télétravail — Possible 2 jours par semaine Durée — 6 mois renouvelable Vos missions Architecture et restauration Définir la stratégie de sauvegarde, d’archivage et de restauration des environnements Proxmox VE et Kubernetes, avec Proxmox Backup Server et Velero. Évaluer et éprouver les solutions open source, notamment Plakar, à travers des preuves de concept. Définir les objectifs de perte de données admissible (RPO) et de délai de reprise (RTO), ainsi que les politiques de rétention, de chiffrement et d’immutabilité. Contribuer aux plans de continuité et de reprise d’activité (PCA/PRA) et aux tests de restauration. Maintenir les dossiers d’architecture et d’exploitation (DAT, HLD/LLD, schémas, matrices de flux), formaliser les standards et défendre les choix techniques devant les instances de gouvernance. Pilotage de la Product Unit Structurer et lancer la Product Unit Backup, définir sa feuille de route, son catalogue de services et son organisation. Prioriser les travaux, répartir la charge, suivre les déploiements et les migrations et accompagner la montée en compétences de l’équipe DevOps. Travailler avec les équipes produit, sécurité, réseau, stockage et cloud, ainsi qu’avec les fournisseurs et les communautés open source. Suivre le taux de succès des sauvegardes, la conformité et les temps de restauration. Contribuer à l’automatisation et à la veille sur la cyber-résilience. Profil recherché 8 à 10 ans d’expérience en infrastructures, dont au moins 3 ans comme architecte ou référent technique, avec une expérience confirmée du pilotage d’équipe ou de projets. Maîtrise indispensable de Proxmox VE et de Proxmox Backup Server. Expérience de Kubernetes et de Velero. Connaissance de Plakar ou forte appétence pour cet outil. Maîtrise des architectures de sauvegarde (3-2-1, immutabilité, air gap, déduplication, chiffrement). Pratique de Linux, du cloud privé et du stockage objet compatible S3. Connaissances DevOps (CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, GitOps) et pratique de l’automatisation (Ansible, Terraform, Bash ou Python). Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles, leadership, pédagogie et capacité à défendre des choix techniques. La connaissance de VMware ou KVM, les contributions open source et l’anglais technique sont appréciés. Pour postuler Joignez votre CV à jour. Indiquez votre date de disponibilité. jobs.title: Machine Learning & AI Internship
jobs.description: WHY this position is important Pennylane builds the financial management and accounting platform used by SMEs and accounting firms in France, Germany and Spain. As a product-led company, we invest first in the product, and AI is now at the core of it. The ML & AI team (about thirty people in Paris, part of the Data organisation) builds the AI inside the product. Its first priority is Autopilot : automated accounting production with the accountant in control. Autopilot reads documents, books entries, matches bank transactions, reviews client files and prepares VAT returns with as little human intervention as possible. These tasks raise real ML problems. Answers must be exact, every client is different, accounting constraints can be checked automatically, and we have millions of real examples corrected by accountants. This internship is a chance to work on one of these problems with real data, real users and a direct path to production. HOW you will contribute You will join the ML & AI team, within a Tech organisation of more than 400 people. You will work on one main topic for the whole internship, protected from day-to-day work, with a dedicated tutor. Every topic follows the same path: Evaluation first : in the first weeks, you agree with your tutor on a frozen evaluation set and the metrics that matter. A baseline in production : you ship a simpler first version that the team can put into production, around months 1 to 3. Then go further : you improve it and explore more advanced approaches. Research topics are designed to lead to a publishable result. You will own the topic end to end: understanding the problem with accountants and product teams, defining success metrics, building, measuring and presenting your results. Topics for 2027 Here is an overview of the topics we want to staff in 2027. We agree on the final topic and your tutor with you. Reading invoices and new types of documents with compact vision-language models (VLMs): fine-tuning, supervision from e-invoices, reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. Knowing when the AI is right : calibrated confidence, selective automation and model routing for automated accounting decisions. Evaluating accounting agents : an open benchmark of long-horizon accounting tasks on simulated client files, with verifiable scoring. Learning from accountants' corrections : turning feedback into editable rules, with non-regression guarantees. Bank reconciliation : matching one transaction to several documents, as learned graph optimisation. An AI agent for Autopilot support tickets : from investigation to a pull request. This is an applied topic for profiles who prefer building systems close to production. Data foundations for AI : evaluation datasets, data quality and monitoring, and agents that let teams query and use data on their own. AI will be part of how you work You will use coding assistants and AI agents every day: to explore the codebase and data models, write Python and SQL, run experiments, write tests and debug. We expect you to give agents the right context and to check their output. You own the result, not the agent. OUR CULTURE You will join a hands-on engineering culture, where two technical co-founders are still among the most active contributors to the codebase. You will work with ML and AI engineers, data specialists, software engineers, product managers and accountants. You will have strong mentorship and a lot of ownership: freedom to test ideas, challenge existing approaches and build things from scratch, with an R&D mindset. The goal is not a demo. It is something the team can trust, reuse and ship. YOU'RE THE RIGHT CANDIDATE IF YOU Are in the final year of a Master's degree or engineering school in machine learning, computer science, statistics or applied mathematics. Research internships of at least 4 months are also considered. Have strong ML foundations and solid Python, and have already trained, fine-tuned or evaluated models in academic

Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions! About this role Growth at Yubo moves fast, and we don’t plan on stopping anytime soon ! jobs.title: Performance Marketer, Acquisition
jobs.description: Who We Are Zefir is building an AI autopilot for home sales in Europe, starting in France. Our agent runs each sale from listing to closing. It coordinates buyers, sellers, and local brokers, manages listings across property portals, and handles the paperwork. We help homeowners sell for the best price on a timeline that works for them. We’ve raised €60 million from Sequoia Capital and other leading investors. Our goal is to help millions of Europeans take the next step in their lives, whether that means moving to a new city for work or making room for a growing family. About the Team Our growth starts with reaching the right sellers and earning their trust. You'll join Growth & Marketing alongside Creative, CRM and Brand, and work in an acquisition squad with teammates from Product, Tech and Operations. A performance marketing agency and freelancers handle part of the day-to-day execution. You'll report to our Growth & Marketing Lead. The Role As our Performance Marketer, Acquisition, you'll own paid acquisition and manage more than €15M in annual spend across Meta, Google, TikTok, ChatGPT and new channels. Your job is to turn that spend into seller leads and booked sales meetings. Our goal is to double seller leads year over year and cut the cost per booked sales meeting by 10%. You'll need to maintain lead quality in a crowded market: Meta and TikTok are starting to compete for the same audiences, and so are Google and ChatGPT. You'll also help us use AI to manage campaigns, produce ads and analyze performance, so the team can manage more spend and run more tests with the same headcount. What You'll Be Able to Do in a Year Ad platforms report clicks and leads. At Zefir, you'll follow those leads through to booked meetings with Sales and use what you learn to decide where to spend. Allocate €15M+ a year by cost per booked meeting. Compare costs across segments and recognise when fewer leads signal better performance. Measure what your campaigns actually add. Design and interpret geo-lift or holdout tests to find out how many extra meetings a campaign generated, and use the results to move budget. Run acquisition with AI. Build your own agents and automations for campaign management, ad production and performance analysis, then measure their impact. Use campaign results to improve creative. Brief and challenge our agency and freelancers, then work with our Content Strategist to turn what you learn into the next round of tests. What You'll Do Set the paid acquisition strategy Set quarterly targets with our Growth & Marketing Lead based on how sellers behave, how the market is changing and what competitors are doing. Decide how to split spend across channels and campaigns to hit those targets and keep generating leads at a sustainable cost beyond the quarter. Find and launch new paid channels and lead-generation partnerships. Own daily performance and the €15M+ budget Optimise campaigns daily with Sales, Brand and Product. When a campaign underperforms, reallocate spend that day. Lead the weekly acquisition review: explain where we missed the plan, what drove the gap and what you'll do to close it. Maximise return on the budget. Use the cost per booked sales meeting in each segment to decide where to put the next euro. Work directly across Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, ChatGPT and new platforms, and know the tracking stack end to end, from Google Tag Manager and server-side tracking to attribution. Measure what drives growth Work with Sales, Product and Data to understand which sellers book a meeting and why, and use those findings to decide what to test and what to change. Agree with Data on what counts as a booked meeting and how to attribute it. Run incrementality tests, including geo-lift studies, to measure how many additional bookings campaigns generate, and compare the results with what the platforms report. Keep testing new channels and campaign ideas, including new creative angles with our Content Strat

jobs.title: Chargé de recouvrement (Freelance, Immobilier)
jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous Zefir construit le pilote automatique IA de la vente immobilière en Europe, en commençant par la France. Notre agent gère chaque vente de la mise en ligne de l'annonce jusqu'à la signature définitive. Il coordonne acheteurs, vendeurs et agents immobiliers locaux, pilote la diffusion des annonces sur les portails et prend en charge toute la partie administrative. Nous aidons les propriétaires à vendre au meilleur prix, dans le calendrier qui leur convient. Nous avons levé 60 millions d'euros auprès de Sequoia Capital et d'autres investisseurs de premier plan. Notre ambition : aider des millions d'Européens à passer à l'étape suivante de leur vie, qu'il s'agisse de déménager pour un nouveau poste ou de faire de la place pour une famille qui s'agrandit. L'équipe Tu travailles avec une équipe de trois personnes, dont un ops et un manager, qui récupère les commissions dues à Zefir et améliore en continu les process de recouvrement. Le rôle Récupérer les commissions dues à Zefir par la négociation amiable, jusqu'au protocole signé, avant le contentieux. Les dossiers sont déjà prêts : à toi d'appeler. Ton indicateur de réussite : le montant recouvré chaque mois, avec un objectif mensuel indexé sur le montant des protocoles signés. Ce que tu feras Mener les appels de recouvrement et négocier jusqu'à l'accord, dans le cadre fixé (montant, plancher, concessions). Produire et envoyer les écrits (mails de suivi, mises en demeure AR24, protocoles transactionnels, dossiers de pièces) avec les outils fournis. Tenir à jour le pipe dans HubSpot (étapes, état des négociations, montants signés), soit une trentaine de dossiers. Contribuer avec l'équipe à l'amélioration des process de recouvrement. Pour toi si Tu sais négocier au téléphone avec des interlocuteurs hostiles ou contrariés : ce sont des conversations exigeantes. Tu es rigoureux·se sur les documents et tu structures ton recouvrement à partir des pièces fournies. Tu écris de façon claire et sobre, y compris des écrits juridiques, avec les outils fournis. Une formation juridique est un plus, pas un impératif. Tu sais mener et suivre une trentaine de dossiers en parallèle avec des délais stricts. Tu es à l'aise avec les outils : HubSpot, transcriptions d'appels, Claude. Une première expérience de recouvrement d'impayés est un plus. Conditions de la mission Mission freelance, avec une forte autonomie : tu pilotes l'activité avec un ops et un manager Sur site, Paris 9e, 5 jours sur 5 Durée : 1 mois renouvelable Rémunération : TJM fixe de 200 € et jusqu'à 150 € de variable par jour, versé à 100 % si l'objectif de recouvrement est atteint, soit jusqu'à 350 € par jour Nos principes 🏔️ Steep Mountains Are Steep : se fixer des objectifs ambitieux et travailler dur pour les atteindre. 🌊 Ride Reality : aller chercher les difficultés et s'adapter vite quand la réalité change. 🏀 Play for the Front of the Jersey : faire passer la réussite de l'équipe avant la reconnaissance individuelle. Candidature et process Nous accueillons les candidatures de toutes et tous, quels que soient le parcours, le genre, l'orientation sexuelle, la religion, l'âge ou l'expérience. Notre équipe valorise l'authenticité et la diversité des points de vue. Nos entretiens reposent sur des mises en situation, des cas pratiques ou des exemples concrets de ton travail passé. Les objectifs et les attentes sont clairs à chaque étape. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Head of Marketing, ET Academy
jobs.description: À propos d'ET Academy ET Academy est la formation créée par Eva ----- 347 000 abonnés sur Instagram), créatrice de contenu voyage. Elle apprend aux créatrices à vivre de leur contenu : trouver des marques, décrocher des collaborations rémunérées, lancer leurs propres offres. Nous proposons deux programmes, Formation et Coaching, vendus en appel par notre équipe sales. Notre acquisition repose sur le contenu organique d'Eva (plus de 1,5 million de vues par semaine sur Instagram), sur nos tunnels (VSL, formations gratuites, ressources ManyChat, communauté Skool, live hebdomadaire) et sur la publicité Meta. Le défi Nous générons beaucoup de leads, mais pas assez de leads qualifiés qui passent à l'achat. Ton rôle est de régler ça, sur trois axes : La pertinence des tunnels : chaque étape, de l'opt‑in au rendez‑vous sales, doit attirer et qualifier les bons profils. Le ciblage : identifier les profils qui convertissent vraiment et orienter les audiences en conséquence. L'idéation : créatives publicitaires, structure des contenus, des posts et des stories. Tes missions Ads et acquisition payante Piloter le Business Manager Meta en autonomie : structure des campagnes, audiences, pixel et événements, budget d'environ 5 000 € par mois. Trouver les angles, écrire les scripts et les accroches, produire ou briefer les créas (vidéo, statique, UGC) avec l'appui de l'IA. Tester chaque semaine de nouvelles créas et audiences, couper ce qui ne marche pas, scaler ce qui marche.
