jobs.title: Junior Business Controller (Data specialist)
jobs.description: Do you enjoy working with numbers, analysing data and finding out what is really happening behind the figures? As Junior Business Controller at HG, you will support our Controllers and Group Financial Controller with financial analyses, reporting and increasingly data-driven insights. At HG, you will work in a compact organisation with an international reach. You will get the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues, take responsibility early and turn financial and business data into insights that help us make better decisions. We value people who are curious, take initiative and have the energy to turn ideas into action. About the role As Junior Business Controller, you will support our Controllers and gradually build your own areas of responsibility. The role combines financial activities with a strong focus on data, analysis and improving management information. You will: support the Business Controllers with financial analyses, reporting and recurring control activities; own and maintain the data model analyse financial and business data and translate it into useful insights; investigate differences, trends and developments and help explain what is happening behind the numbers; build, review and improve data models used for reporting and analysis; use various tools including Excel and Power BI to make information clearer and easier to use; investigate how data flows from source to report and identify opportunities to improve data quality and reporting; help reduce manual work by finding smarter and more reliable ways of working; contribute to improvements in management information and financial processes; translate questions from colleagues into practical analyses and insights. An important part of the role is conceptual thinking about data. You understand how information should be structured, see connections between different data points and can think about how a data model can be improved to provide better business insights. Your development in data Next to your finance responsibilities, you will grow step by step into the data side of the role, coached by our current Data Specialist. You do not need to master these areas from day one: together we will set up a development path in which you learn to: contribute to HG's Business Intelligence and data strategy, making sure data supports our company goals; design and maintain data models (such as star schemas) and database/Lakehouse structures, so that data is accurate, reliable and accessible; integrate data from different sources and systems in a medallion model (Bronze for raw data, Silver for engineering, Gold for consumption); manage the HG Data Dictionary, data repositories and the underlying data architecture; apply data governance and data quality practices, including audit trails, data privacy requirements and best-practice frameworks such as DAMA; map business processes (BPMN 2.0) and translate business requirements into practical data solutions; work with tools such as SQL, Python (pandas), Power Query, Power Automate and Microsoft Fabric, and over time explore AI techniques; document data models and data processes, and monitor data systems for performance and reliability. This gives you a strong combination of finance and data expertise, which is becoming increasingly valuable in modern Business Control. Collaboration & positioning You will be part of the Finance team and work closely with our Business Controllers. This gives you the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues while contributing your own analytical and data-driven perspective. Because HG is a relatively compact organisation, you will have direct contact with colleagues across different disciplines. This means you can quickly see how your analyses and improvements are being used in the business. At the same time, you will work within an international organisation, with colleagues and markets across Europe. The role is based at our head office in Almere. HG is a compact, fast-grow

jobs.title: Android Engineer
jobs.description: Who are we? We're a smart hydration company rebuilding an industry that still runs on sugar water and single-use packaging. Filtered water, functional flavors, zero bottles. Still, sparkling, cold, and hot. All poured from one tap. We create hydration people want to reach for, starting with the workplace where we help teams thrive. As an AI-native company, we build at speed. In 2025, Aquablu ranked 2nd in the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 (Netherlands) and 30th in the Sifted 250 (Europe), both rankings of the fastest-growing companies by revenue growth. In 2026 we were named a winner of Maya's Culture 100 Europe Awards as one of the best workplaces to thrive in. Growing that fast and thriving comes down to our people. Our team is our biggest asset and one that we’re proud of. We’re committed to maintaining our vibrant culture as we continue to grow. About the role Aquablu's products run Android in more places than your pocket. Our dispensing systems ship with Android-powered on-device software that hundreds of thousands of people touch every day, and our mobile apps put hydration in users' hands. As our Android Engineer, you work across that whole surface. Your main arena is on-device: the software running on the hardware itself, where Android meets the physical world. Screens people tap on a machine, software that talks to firmware, updates that roll out to hundreds of deployed systems in the field. Alongside that, you contribute to our mobile development where the products need it. Few Android roles give you this range. This is a hands-on engineering role in a small, fast team. You own features end to end and deliver them reliably, reaching out to your manager when support is needed to unblock you. You build with AI agents as your default collaborator, you work cross-functionally with hardware, firmware, and product, proactively identifying and reaching out to key players that can help filling any gaps. This role reports into our Head of Digital Product, and is part of Aquablu’s Software & Intelligence Engineering team. What You'll Build & Own On-device Android software: Features on the user-facing software running on our dispensing systems — UI, device behaviour, and the integration layer where software meets hardware. You own your features end to end. Fleet-ready releases: Contribute to releases that update reliably across hundreds of deployed devices in the field, where a broken release means a technician visit. The riskiest releases get a second pair of senior eyes — and you learn what makes them safe. Hardware & firmware integration: Work with embedded and firmware engineers to define and implement serial APIs (UART), that expose device state and trigger mechanical actions. Mobile contribution: Support Android development on our consumer app where the roadmap needs it. AI-native development: Build with AI agents every day and keep pushing what that lets you ship. What You Bring Solid Android engineering experience: A minimum of 3-5 years building and shipping Android apps in Kotlin, with a solid grasp of the platform (lifecycle, concurrency). You should be able to judge which Android patterns fit a non-standard system, and to design features that contribute to a scalable, reliable system. Curiosity for Android beyond the traditional mobile world: kiosk, embedded, or AOSP work is a strong plus. Pragmatic problem solver who’s comfortable working outside of familiar mobile patterns. Work independently on well-scoped tasks. When scope is unclear, flag it, reach out to the right people, and get the answers and support you need to unblock yourself. Plan the work, communicate progress early, and deliver end to end. AI-native coding is how you work. You build with AI agents daily, you have a sharp setup, and your output shows it. If your last six months of work doesn't look meaningfully different because of AI, this isn't your role. ✨ Why join us? 💰 A salary between 66-89k yearly (incl. 8% holiday allowance) 📈 Equity

jobs.title: Interim Payments & Operations Senior Specialist - Freelance Assignment
jobs.description: Freelance Assignment 4 January to 30 April 2027 5 days a week, with 3 days in the office (Mondays, Wednesdays & Thursdays) Reporting to COO The Challenge Every day, people in 180+ countries top up Talk360 to call someone who matters. A parent back home. An important work call to close the deal. When a payment fails, the call never happens. It's not a checkout glitch; it's a missed conversation. Payments at Talk360 is not simple. Our callers pay with cards, wallets and local bank transfers, through different providers in different markets, from the Netherlands to Nigeria, South Africa and Ghana. Every provider, method and market behaves a little differently, and a small shift in authorisation or decline rates is real money and real people not getting through. We're a lean company of around 30 people, profitable since 2025, and growing beyond our core app into calling for work and embedded calling for partners. Ewan, who runs our ops today and payments, is away from mid January to mid April on paternity leave. The assignment runs 4 January to 30 April. We're looking for an interim who does two jobs at once: keep operations running and go deep on payments to create order, so that when Ewan is back he has an operating model and a plan he can run with. Strategic enough to see the whole picture. Hands-on enough to fix what's broken before lunch. What You'll Do Keep things running Keep ops moving: Take over the daily ops Ewan runs today: monitoring and alerts, Support escalations, incidents, and the automations behind them. Know who repairs each one when it breaks. Run verification: Own verification (OTP) performance and cost: weekly conversion and failure review, a monthly cost check, and follow-up with Product and Tech when something slips. Go deep on payments Get up to speed: Learn how payments works for Talk360 fast, starting from Ewan's existing work: NjiaPay, our payment orchestrator, and our PSPs (Adyen, PayPal, Startbutton, Paystack, Ozow and more). Then go deep where it moves conversion and cost most. Fix it weekly: Watch authorisation, 3DS and decline rates, and hold the balance between chargebacks and payment friction, including the fraud rules that move both. Catch drops early, find the cause and fix it together with our providers' account managers. Create order: By the end of April, hand Ewan a payments operating model (who owns what across Ops, Product and Finance, the KPIs, the weekly and monthly rhythm) and a prioritised plan he can execute. What You'll Bring Must have 5+ years in payments at a high-volume consumer business (fintech, e-commerce, or similar), with both a strategic and a hands-on side. Hands-on experience with payment providers such as Adyen and PayPal: authorisation rates, 3DS / SCA, chargebacks and disputes. Hands-on experience with fraud rules, ideally Adyen risk rules: you can judge what a rule change does to chargebacks and to conversion. Active, daily use of AI and automation tools. You don't need to build automations, but you can read, run and triage them (we use n8n and Claude skills). A track record of turning a messy area into an operating model: owners, KPIs, rhythm and a plan others can execute. You pick things up fast and learn fast: you are productive in a new area within days, not weeks. Nice to have Payments in emerging markets such as Nigeria, South Africa, Ghana or Kenya: bank transfers, mobile money, local providers. Experience with OTP or verification performance and cost. Experience with Omni dashboards. Who You Are Strategic and hands-on: You can think about where our payments set-up should go in the morning and fix a failing provider flow by lunch. An owner: You pick up a seat that isn't yours after about two weeks of handover and run it without needing a brief, then hand it back in better shape than you found it. Orderly: You write down what you decided and why, so the next person doesn't have to guess. A bridge between teams: You work easily between Finance, Product, Support

jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at <u><span><a href="http://grafana.com" target="_blank">grafana.com</a></span></u> and follow us on <u><span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/grafana-labs/" target="_blank">LinkedIn</a></span></u> and <u><span><a href="https://twitter.com/grafana" target="_blank">X</a></span></u><u>.</u></p> <p>We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.</p> <p>You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.</p></div><p>This is a remote opportunity and we are looking for candidates from the UK, Sweden, Spain or Germany.</p> <h3><strong>About the role:</strong></h3> <p>Grafana Cloud runs Mimir, Loki, Tempo and Pyroscope as multi-tenant SaaS databases across AWS, GCP and Azure in regions worldwide. Our highest-SLA customers depend on them to run their businesses. We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to keep these systems reliable at scale.</p> <p>The role combines building and operating. You’ll write the software, automation and product changes that make our databases more reliable, including changes to the Mimir, Loki and Tempo codebases where reliability calls for it. You’ll also be on call for our highest-SLA customers and handle the operational work that comes with it. You’ll bring a production mindset to product engineering and engineering rigor to reliability, and you’ll set technical direction across squads.</p> <h3><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Build reliability into the product.</strong> Write production code in our services, tooling and the Mimir, Loki and Tempo codebases that makes our databases more resilient, self-healing and scalable as demand grows quickly.</li> <li><strong>Build automation and platform tooling</strong> that removes toil and scales our reliability practices across regions and cloud providers.</li> <li><strong>Lead technical design.</strong> Author design docs, review others’ designs and PRs, and shape feature design so it’s scalable and operable from day one.</li> <li><strong>Own the SLO framework.</strong> Define and evolve per-tenant SLOs and reliability models. Use SLO burn and incident learnings to find and fix the causes of failure in the systems themselves.</li> <li><strong>Improve observability and alerting</strong> so we find problems before customers do, and so escalations are actionable rather than noisy.&

jobs.description: <p>Department: Platform Infrastructure</p> <p>Location: Berlin, Germany&nbsp;</p> <h2>Team description</h2> <p>You’ll join the newly formed Developer Experience team, which improves how around 700 SumUp engineers build, ship, and observe software. The team builds the internal tools, services, and abstractions that make infrastructure invisible to product teams. That includes modernising an observability stack that has grown organically and shaping what useful debugging looks like for both engineers and AI agents. This role is software engineering first and DevOps aware second. You’ll define open-ended problems before solving them, and you’ll build agreement across product engineering, Cloud Infrastructure and Site Reliability Engineering.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li>Design, build and evolve services for developer tooling, such as cost reporting, observability pipelines, internal APIs and command line tools</li> <li>Build and extend the internal observability platform so systems are easy for developers to understand and act on</li> <li>Take ownership of components in the observability stack (Loki, Grafana, Prometheus, Alloy and exporters) and improve them</li> <li>Explore what telemetry and debugging context AI agents need, compared with human engineers</li> <li>Create automation, self-service features, and integrations that reduce manual work for product engineering teams</li> <li>Lead design discussions, write and review RFCs, mentor mid-level and junior engineers, and raise standards through code review</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li>Strong software engineering fundamentals (Go preferred), with a proven track record of shipping production backend services, command-line tools, or platform tooling.</li> <li>Solid understanding of observability and OpenTelemetry (metrics, logs, traces, SLIs and SLOs) and hands-on experience building observability tooling or integrations. Familiarity with Honeycomb or Grafana is a strong plus.</li> <li>Working knowledge of Kubernetes as a user, and comfort with Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD, and CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions to deliver your own services.</li> <li>Experience mentoring engineers and leading design discussions, supported by excellent written and verbal communication and a documentation-first mindset.</li> <li>A platform engineering mindset that treats internal developers as customers, with a bias toward shipping and iterating, comfort with ambiguity, and a habit of digging into root causes.</li> </ul> <h2 class="cui-headline-64we cui-headline-l-bth2 css-1cpk9mt e173j6r80">Why you should join SumUp</h2> <p class="cui-body-gccz cui-body-m-0hb4 cui-body-regular-g1zg cui-body-normal-pxkh css-k4eprn">🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. jobs.title: Backend Engineer - Cards
jobs.description: <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">SumUp builds simple, affordable financial tools that help small businesses get paid, manage their money, and grow. Beyond payments, we offer a number of financial products - including business banking, card products, lending, and invoicing - giving merchants everything they need to manage their payments and finances in one place.<br><br>The <strong>Cards squad </strong>is a core part of that, owning the systems that power card issuing, lifecycle management, and transaction processing for merchants across Europe. We handle millions of card transactions every day, and we're now scaling those systems to support new product capabilities while laying the foundations for a more global, resilient platform. That's why we're growing the team and looking for a seasoned backend engineer who can take real ownership of complex, high-impact work. jobs.description: Our Mission At Omegga, we develop spectral intelligence: we combine AI and spectroscopy to make the invisible visible. We started with a clear objective: eliminate chick culling on a global scale through early, non-invasive in-ovo sex detection. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world. We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Freelance Market Specialist for the German market to support our Localization and Product Marketing teams at KAYAK. This unique role combines the strategic elements of product marketing with the linguistic expertise required for high-quality localization. The ideal candidate will improve our messaging, positioning, and in-product communications while ensuring the highest standards of linguistic quality and cultural relevance in our localized content. Are you passionate about translating product marketing strategies into resonating copies to attract your local audience? Then join us at Booking Holdings and help craft the future of travel! Als Graduate Operations Supervisor (m/w/d) in unserem Fulfillment Center (FC) in <strong>Hamburg</strong> bist du der strategische und menschliche Kopf auf dem Shopfloor. Unterstützt von Investoren wie der <em>Gates Foundation</em> bauen wir gemeinsam das modernste Liefersystem Europas – mit 100% elektrischer Auslieferung bis an die Haustür unserer KundInnen.</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/o1FOzeb4YYs" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <h2><strong>Das erwartet dich&nbsp;</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Teamleitung: </strong>Du bist Coach, Mentor und echtes Vorbild auf der Fläche. Mit ehrlichem Interesse an Menschen hörst du aktiv zu, erkennst Leistungen an und entwickelst dein Team aus 5 Teamleitenden und über 120 Lagermitarbeitenden – auf Augenhöhe und mit Empathie.</li> <li><strong>Schichtleitung: </strong>Direkt im Geschehen auf dem FC Shopfloor (3–4 Tage/Woche) lebst du unsere Shopfloor First Mentalität. Du behältst den strategischen Überblick, triffst kluge Entscheidungen im Tagesgeschäft und befähigst deine Teamleitenden durch gezieltes, wertschöpfendes Feedback, jeden Tag ihr Bestes für unsere KundInnen zu geben.</li> <li><strong>Prozessoptimierung:</strong> Du schaust hinter die Kulissen. Im FC Office (1–2 Tage/Woche) analysierst du Kennzahlen, erkennst Engpässe frühzeitig und leitest daraus clevere Maßnahmen ab – immer mit dem Blick darauf, ob deine Lösungen die Arbeit auf dem Shopfloor spürbar verbessern.</li> <li><strong>Projektmanagement: </strong>Echte Veränderungen entstehen bei uns direkt auf dem Shopfloor. Du hinterfragst den Status quo, sprichst Abweichungen offen an und hebst unsere Abläufe mit eigenen Logistikprojekten nachhaltig aufs nächste Level.</li> <li><strong>Ownership:</strong> Du führst deine Schichten, als wäre es dein eigenes Unternehmen. Du denkst über deinen Tellerrand hinaus, erkennst Herausforderungen proaktiv und übernimmst Verantwortung für langfristige Verbesserungen – auch abteilungsübergreifend.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Das bringst du mit</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor oder Master) – idealerweise in Logistik, Supply Chain Management, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem analytisch geprägten Studiengang.</li> <li>Du liebst es, komplexe Zusammenhänge zu durchdringen, Daten zu verstehen und pragmatische Lösungen zu entwickeln, die auf dem Shopfloor echte Ergebnisse liefern. (Keine Sorge vor fehlender Lagererfahrung: Mit unserem intensiven Coaching wirst du in kürzester Zeit zum Vollprofi auf dem Shopfloor!)</li> <li>Du bist empathisch, nahbar und motivierst andere mit Leichtigkeit. Du hörst aufmerksam zu, löst Konflikte konstruktiv und hast Freude daran, Talente im Team gezielt zu fördern.</li> <li>Du triffst auf dem Shopfloor wie im Office immer den richtigen Ton, sprichst Dinge klar an und kommunizierst sicher und souverän auf Deutsch und Englisch.</li> <li>Du siehst Feedback als wichtigstes Werkzeug für gemeinsames Wachstum, nimmst Coaching dankbar an und bringst die nötige Flexibilität für die Arbeit in zwei Schichten (6:00 – 14:30 Uhr &amp; 14:30 – 23:00 Uhr, inkl. jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description: About us Workerbase builds the operating system for the shopfloor: software that guides and coordinates the work of people in factories. Manufacturing and logistics companies use it to digitalize their processes in production, maintenance and quality. Our customers include international groups from automotive, steel and the supplier industry. We run the platform as a managed service on our own container infrastructure and support customers who host it themselves. We are ISO 27001 certified and hold a TISAX label. Your role You join a small platform team and share responsibility with our Senior DevOps Engineer for running, securing and developing our infrastructure. You are not the "security person on the sidelines". You run the platform and build security straight into pipelines, clusters and processes. What you'll do Operations: You run and develop our production container orchestration clusters: provisioning, upgrades, scaling, cost. Deployments: You manage customer instances the GitOps way: declarative, versioned and reproducible. That covers rollouts, version management and migrations, in our clusters and in customers' on-prem environments. Infrastructure as code: You develop our infrastructure as code, so every change is reviewed, versioned and repeatable. Security: You build security into the platform, pipelines and processes, from vulnerability management to the secure configuration of clusters and workloads. CI/CD: You develop our build and delivery pipelines, including automated quality and security checks. Observability and on-call: You look after monitoring and alerting, take part in the on-call rotation, handle incidents and write post-mortems. Backup and disaster recovery: You make sure data from our databases and object storage is backed up and can actually be restored when it matters. Compliance: You provide the technical input for ISO 27001 and other security requirements from our customers. Collaboration: You advise the development teams on architecture, security, containerization and deployments, and give technical support to customers who host the platform themselves. What you bring Several years of experience running container orchestration platforms in production , not just deploying to them Confident with GitOps, declarative deployments and infrastructure as code A practical understanding of security : container hardening, access control, network segmentation, secrets management, vulnerability management, least privilege Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines Linux, networking, DNS and TLS are solid tools of the trade for you Experience with monitoring and incident handling , and willingness to take part in the on-call rotation You work independently, document what you do, and say no when something is not secure Very good German and English , as some customer contact is in German Nice to have Managing many clusters across different environments, including on-prem Policy as code: enforcing security and compliance rules automatically Running relational and document databases and message queues in production Experience with ISO 27001 or TISAX from the technical side Public cloud platforms and edge security services Scripting or programming for automation What we offer Office in Munich Real influence: a small team, short decision paths, no ticket factory A modern, well-documented stack that is already managed as code Working with current AI coding tools day to day Wellpass membership Learning & Development Budget JobRad subscription Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: 📈 Who We Are: We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair. We're rebuilding how energy is bought and sold. That means cutting out middlemen, connecting businesses directly with renewable generators, and ensuring every transaction is traceable and transparent . We're a 180+ person team - operators, data scientists, engineers, customer champions and energy experts - backed by top-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Hitachi Ventures, Allianz, AlbionVC and Atomico. We closed a $75M Series B round in early 2026, taking our total funding to $94M, and we now power energy for over 4,000 UK businesses across 8,500+ sites , with over £75m in value returned to businesses and generators so far. We're a technology company solving the energy industry, not an energy company. Some people call us a neo-utility, the neo-bank idea, applied to energy. The industry is noticing. We were crowned Europe's Most Exciting Tech Company at the GP Bullhound Allstars awards , came in at #6 on LinkedIn's Top Startups 2026 in the UK, #7 on the Scaling Europe 50 of Europe's fastest-growing companies, and #14 on Sifted's AI 100 . Learn more about us on our website . 🚀 The Role We're hiring Product Engineers at Staff, Senior Staff, and Principal level across three of our engines: Buy, Sell and Third Party Access (TPA). A Product Engineer at tem gets handed a problem, not a ticket. You sit inside an engine, next to the account managers, partners and customers who live with the problem. You work out what to build, build it, and stay with it after launch until you can show it moved the metric. Product sets the bet and the guidance, not the feature list, so nobody writes your tickets for you. This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a people-management one. We will talk to you about which engine fits you best, and where your experience and interests line up. Buy: Buy is where businesses pay less for clean power. It's the side of tem that runs RED for the UK businesses on it: quotes with every cost up front, bills itemised line by line, and a switch from quote to live in minutes, not days. You'd build the products and systems behind that, from tender to signed contract to a bill with nothing to hide, and make it work just as well for the next thousand sites as it does for the first. Sell: Sell is where generators earn more for what they produce. We contract with UK solar, wind, hydro, anaerobic digestion, biomass and EfW sites, from single farms to multi-site portfolios, through broker partners and direct. You'd build the tools that get generators signed faster, show them exactly what they're earning, and get them paid on time, every time. You'd also open up new kinds of sites we can't contract today, so there's more clean power to put in front of businesses. Third Party Access (TPA): TPA builds the new transaction rails for our partners. It lets brokers, banks, affiliates and generators sell tem's energy under their own brand, running on Rosso, our pricing engine. You'd design and build the partner APIs, branded portals, billing and settlement that make that work, and take a 0 to 1 product from pilot to production. In TPA you'll also be partner-facing, embedding with partners to get them integrated and live. 📆 In your first 12 months, you might: Sit with the account managers, partners and customers in your engine, run discovery calls yourself and turn what you hear into a clear problem to solve. Decide what to build and what to leave out, then design and ship it without waiting for a spec. Ship work that moves a named business metric, and stay with it until you can show the number moved. In TPA, help take partner integrations from pilot to production, live and working. Mentor engineers around you and share what you learn with teams across the business. 🛠️ Responsibilities Own discovery: Work directly with the commercial team, partners and customers to find the real problem, proactively engaging them and running

jobs.title: Account Executive, Early Stage - UK&I
jobs.description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. Vanta is growing fast, consistently exceeding our growth targets, and maintaining exceptionally strong NPS scores along the way. Our momentum is driven by a clear mission: to secure the internet and help startups scale with trust. As the category leader in compliance and security automation, we’re capturing market share rapidly, and our Sales team is at the forefront of that charge. To support this continued growth, we’re expanding our Early Stage Sales team. We’re looking for high-energy, customer-focused Account Executives who thrive in high-volume, fast-paced environments and are motivated by the challenge of turning velocity into results. In this role, you’ll take full ownership of the sales cycle, from first touch to close, and play a critical role in positioning Vanta as the go-to solution for early-stage companies navigating security and compliance for the first time. This is a highly transactional, new business role where success comes from running a tight, repeatable process and maintaining a high daily output. If you love the energy of working with startups, are driven to outperform targets, and want to make a tangible impact in a rapidly scaling business, we’d love to hear from you. This role will be based in our London office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday. What you’ll do as an Account Executive, Startups - EMEA at Vanta: Identify high-potential business verticals to develop and execute outbound strategies to engage them with Vanta. Manage the entire sales cycle, from initial contact to contract negotiation and closing, with a focus on speed and efficiency, aiming to close deals within a 30-day timeframe. Turn our inbound demand into closed-won business quickly and consistently, working across a large number of prospects Operate in a fast-paced, transactional sales environment, running a high number of discovery calls and managing a broad pipeline of opportunities simultaneously. Continuously optimize your sales workflow to maintain high activity levels, improve conversion, and deliver repeatable results. Define and communicate the value of Vanta to prospects, including tailoring sales materials and demos to resonate with early-stage startup buyers Surface product feedback and trends from prospects to inform go-to-market and product development strategies. How to be successful in this role: Have 12+ months in a closing and quota-carrying role, while consistently exceeding monthly and quarterly sales targets Experience in B2B SaaS, ideally focused on SMB or early-stage startups, where short deal cycles and high activity are the norm Thrive in high-velocity sales environments and are energized by repetition, fast decision-making, and a transactional approach to deal flow Be highly empathetic to customers, with a proven track record of long-term customer retention. Possess the technical competency to understand Vanta’s software and build great relationships with highly technical prospects. Have stellar problem-solving chops, and an enthusiasm for making a large impact early on at a start-up. You’re intrinsically motivated, proactive, and resourceful—comfortable taking initiative without needing direction Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact What you can expect as a Vanta'n: Industry-competitive salary and equity 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents Health & wel

We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone , regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality. jobs.title: Senior Commercial Technology Lawyer
jobs.description: At Acturis, innovation isn’t just part of our culture - it’s in our DNA. Our journey began in 2000, when our founders set out to transform the way technology supports the insurance industry. Since then, we’ve grown from a UK start-up into an international technology group, bringing together a number of businesses, products and specialist teams across the UK, Europe and North America. At the heart of the Group is our market-leading SaaS platform, used by over 100,000 people in 40+ countries. Alongside this, our wider Group businesses provide technology and services across different areas of the insurance ecosystem, giving us an increasingly diverse and international footprint. We’re continuing to grow through international expansion, new products and services, and strategic acquisitions. That means the opportunities and challenges we take on are constantly evolving - whether we’re entering a new market, integrating a new business, developing AI-enabled products or supporting customers in highly regulated environments. You’ll join an ambitious organisation where expertise is valued, decisions move quickly and talented people can make a genuine impact across the wider Group. Day to day you will: Lead complex commercial technology work across a growing international group, including structuring, negotiating and advising on SaaS, technology licensing, customer and supplier agreements, data, AI and emerging digital regulation. Partner with senior leaders across the business to understand legal and commercial risk, make pragmatic recommendations and help move decisions and deals forward. Play a senior role within the Legal team, remaining hands-on with your own work while managing and developing junior colleagues , and driving building and maintaining legal function operational excellence.   We offer a clear progression path and the opportunity to take genuine ownership as the Acturis Group continues to grow internationally. You’ll work closely with senior leaders, take responsibility for complex legal matters and play an active role in developing the wider Legal team and function. You can expect: The opportunity to take ownership of key areas of the Group and influence commercial and strategic decisions. To join a collegiate legal team with a strong reputation, both inside the company and across our industry, and who hold ourselves to high standards, work closely together, and take pride in the difference we make. A clear progression structure, regular feedback and ongoing career development. Support for relevant professional development and training as your role and responsibilities evolve. You’ll thrive here if: You’re a UK-qualified lawyer with 7+ years’ PQE with a combination of both private practice background in the City or a large regional practice and strong in-house commercial technology experience, ideally within a SaaS, software or technology business. You have deep knowledge of practice areas that underpin the commercial practice, including contract law, IP and privacy, including evolving regulatory frameworks. You’re commercially minded, decisive and comfortable operating at pace, able to cut through complexity, prioritise material risks and find practical ways forward. You have strong communication stills, a proactive mindset and the ability to navigate ambiguity in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. You enjoy variety and ownership, whether that’s negotiating a complex SaaS agreement, advising on AI or data regulation, supporting an acquisition or coaching a junior lawyer. You have a strong work ethic with an eye for detail. You're a true team player who supports colleagues and works collaboratively across all Verticals of the business to drive growth and strategic initiatives. Ready to use your expertise to help shape the future of insurance technology? Join Acturis and take on a role where your impact is immediate, your ideas matter, and your progression is limitless.   Please note Acturis is an equal oppor

jobs.title: AI Solution Architect
jobs.description: Location: London Contract Type: 12-month contract Day Rate: £650–£750 per day We are looking for an experienced AI Solution Architect to join our Technology team, working onsite with a Tier 1 Bank in London on an initial 12-month contract. This is a hands-on role focused on designing and delivering scalable, production-ready AI solutions within a complex financial services environment. You will work across business, product, engineering and data teams, taking solutions from initial concept through to deployment and production. You will have particular expertise in Generative AI and LLM technologies, including RAG, agentic AI, document and unstructured data processing, and machine learning. We’re looking for someone who combines strong solution architecture expertise with a pragmatic approach to security, governance, scalability and production delivery. Key Responsibilities Design end-to-end architecture for AI-enabled solutions, covering applications, data, integrations and production environments. Translate business requirements into practical, scalable technical solutions. Select appropriate AI approaches, including Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, machine learning and hybrid solutions. Define APIs, integrations and data contracts across upstream and downstream systems. Ensure security, privacy, resilience and appropriate controls are embedded into solution design. Define non-functional requirements including availability, performance, latency, scalability and cost. Support deployment, monitoring, versioning and ongoing lifecycle management of AI solutions. Work closely with engineering teams to break architecture into deliverable solutions and resolve technical challenges. Produce clear architecture documentation, designs and technical decision records. Identify opportunities to create reusable architecture patterns and components. Manage technical risks, dependencies and architectural decisions throughout delivery. Skills & Experience Essential Proven experience as a Solution Architect within complex enterprise environments. Strong experience designing end-to-end technology solutions across applications, APIs, integration and data. Good understanding of AI and Generative AI architecture, including LLMs and RAG. Experience taking solutions from initial design through to production. Strong understanding of APIs, integration patterns and data contracts. Experience defining non-functional requirements across performance, resilience, security and scalability. Strong understanding of security, privacy and controls-by-design. Ability to make pragmatic technical decisions and clearly communicate architectural trade-offs. Strong stakeholder management skills across business and technology teams. Experience working within fast-paced Agile or product-led delivery environments. Desirable Experience working within banking, capital markets or wider financial services. Experience delivering technology within highly regulated environments. Knowledge of agentic AI and AI-enabled workflow automation. Experience with MLOps/LLMOps, including deployment, monitoring, versioning and rollback. Experience designing solutions involving document processing or unstructured data. Experience creating reusable architecture patterns or frameworks. How We Work: Delta Capita is an equal opportunity employer. We agree the goal, and you find the way.</li> <li><strong>Travel opportunity.</strong> You will be joining our 10+ conferences.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you will do</strong></h2> <p>Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Build the audience.</strong> Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.</li> <li><strong>Own marketing channels that drive revenue. </strong>Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue</li> <li><strong>Write copy that persuades.</strong> Every email, landing page and post. jobs.description: <p>At mthree, we connect talented graduates with top tier organizations, including leading investment banks and companies across insurance, travel, and more. We currently have a Data Engineer role with a leading financial company.</p> <p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a Data Engineer to design, build and maintain scalable cloud-native data pipelines that transform data into trusted, AI-ready datasets. The role will focus on data modelling, curation, governance and the delivery of high-quality datasets that support analytics, AI and business decision-making.</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>London or Glasgow - 5 days onsite</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities </strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the development and maintenance of cloud-based data pipelines using modern data engineering practices.</li> <li>Work with the team to ingest, transform and deliver data from a variety of vendor and market data sources.</li> <li>Help build and maintain reliable, accurate and accessible datasets for internal users and applications.</li> <li>Assist with developing data models and data structures to support new datasets and business requirements.</li> <li>Work with large datasets and learn how to build solutions that can process and manage data at scale.</li> <li>Support the implementation of data quality checks, monitoring and governance processes.</li> <li>Help prepare AI-ready and analytics-ready datasets for use by internal teams and applications.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to improve data quality, performance and reliability, working closely with more experienced engineers.</li> <li>Collaborate with data engineering, analytics, product and governance teams to understand requirements and deliver data solutions.</li> <li>Learn and apply best practices in data engineering, cloud technologies and data management as part of the role.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Skills &amp; Experience </strong></p> <ul> <li>Degree in Data Science, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a closely related subject.</li> <li>Good understanding of data engineering concepts, including data pipelines, data transformation and data management.</li> <li>Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with an interest in working with large datasets.</li> <li>Understanding of databases and SQL.</li> <li>Experience with Databricks or Snowflake is highly desirable, but not essential.</li> <li>Strong attention to detail and a willingness to learn new technologies.</li> <li>Good communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with technical and non-technical teams.</li> <li>Any industry placement, internship or project experience in data engineering, data analytics or data science would be an advantage.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>How to Apply</strong></p> <ol> <li>Apply&nbsp;via&nbsp;the&nbsp;form&nbsp;below.</li> <li>Engage&nbsp;in&nbsp;video&nbsp;interviews&nbsp;with&nbsp;our&nbsp;friendly&nbsp;talent&nbsp;team&nbsp;(30&nbsp;min&nbsp;video&nbsp;call)</li> <li>Tech assessment</li> <li>Interview&nbsp;directly&nbsp;with&nbsp;our&nbsp;client</li> </ol> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Diversity&nbsp;and&nbsp;Inclusion&nbsp;at&nbsp;mthree</strong></p> <p><em>At&nbsp;mthree,&nbsp;we&nbsp;celebrate&nbsp;diversity&nbsp;and&nbsp;foster&nbsp;an&nbsp;environment&nbsp;where&nbsp;everyone&am

jobs.description: Our Security and IT team keeps the 360Learning platform secure, compliant and auditable for the 1,500 organisations that learn on it every day. Étudier et mettre en œuvre des mécanismes de gestion des erreurs, de rollback et de sécurisation des migrations. Ce stage offre l'opportunité de travailler sur un sujet à forte dimension technique, mêlant génie logiciel, architecture C++, Intelligence Artificielle générative et automatisation , avec des applications concrètes dans le domaine ferroviaire. Cette réforme s'accompagne d'une évolution des systèmes d'information nécessaires aux échanges avec la Commission européenne. Le SGAE envisage de confier à l'ASP le rôle d'opérateur technique du futur système d’information (SI)  de coordination nationale, articulé autour d'un système de gestion des déclarations de paiement et d'un système décisionnel de suivi des opérations (7 applicatifs à construire). Validation des architectures proposées. Alignement métier et valorisation des données : Capacité à comprendre les besoins métiers, à les traduire en solutions techniques (pipelines, Modélisation des données et Conception de schémas (MCD, MPD). Contribution à la stratégie data du SI PPNR Champs relationnel En interne : Direction des Soutiens Directs Agricoles (DSDA), Direction du Développement Rural et de la Pêche (DDRP), Mission de coordination des organismes payeurs des fonds agricoles (MCFA), Direction Numérique et des Systèmes d’information (DNSI) En externe : Secrétariat général des affaires européennes (SGAE), Ministère de l’agriculture et de la souveraineté alimentaire, Conseils régionaux, Organismes payeurs français, Auditeurs (français et européens), les maîtrises d’œuvre (MOE) en charge du développement et de l’exploitation du SI PPNR Savoirs

jobs.title: Enterprise Core Sales Engineer - France
jobs.description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: As an Enterprise Core Sales Engineer at Samsara, you'll be splitting your time across two major focus areas; (1) supporting senior-level sellers in an attempt to grow existing customers, or win new customers, and (2) contributing to the SE Team as a senior resource. There is an expectation that an Enterprise SE is highly accountable for each technical sale, meaning that strong storytelling, objection handling, custom workarounds, advanced integrations, and extensive hands-on experience are requirements to win most deals. Takeaways from these activities should be shared across the SE Team via team meetings, messaging tools, etc. Additionally, an Enterprise Core Sales Engineer is accountable for carving out time to source and deliver product information, conduct testing of alpha products/features, manage projects, and build process improvements and automation that will scale the broader SE Team. A successful Enterprise Core Sales Engineer will possess excellent time management skills and will maintain a clear focus on retiring quota in addition to these other senior responsibilities. This is a remote position open to candidates residing in France.  This position requires travel up to 50% of the time. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment. You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers. You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.  You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focus on winning as a team. In this role, you will:   Conduct product demonstrations and facilitate live proof-of-concept trials for prospective customers, and ensure these prospects understand - and are fully utilizing - the Samsara platform. Work closely with Product Management, and other relevant teams, to help develop the Samsara platform. Demonstrate the value proposition of Samsara's products and services along with the platform's core capabilities on-site, remotely via webinar sessions, or at field events such as conferences and trade shows. Respond to functional and technical

jobs.description: INGENIEUR É TUDES CFO H/F   MDC RECRUTEMENT , Cabinet de Recrutement référence dans la filière Datacenter, recherchons pour notre client, acteur majeur du Datacenter, un INGENIEUR ÉTUDES CFO H/F , dans le cadre de son développement. Vos Missions   La coordination des interfaces techniques entre les différentes disciplines (CFA, CVC, sûreté) afin d’avoir notamment un bilan de puissance le plus précis possible (selon la phase d’avancement du projet) et les alimentations électriques correspondant aux besoins de chaque lot. L’optimisation des solutions pour garantir performance énergétique, fiabilité et conformité aux normes en vigueur. Le dimensionnement et la conception des installations électriques HTA, Groupe électrogène (secours) et BT des data centers pour toutes les phases AVP d’un projet : faisabilité, APS, APD, PRO-DCE. L’élaboration des cahiers des charges techniques (Notices APS, Notices APD et CCTP) et suivre les études en phase avant-projet. La réalisation de la mission VISA des études d’exécution des entreprises en charges du lot CFO. Assurer une veille technologique et réglementaire pour intégrer les dernières avancées du secteur.   La maitrise de la HTB n’est pas obligatoire mais est très appréciable. Votre Profil Ingénieur en génie électrique, électrotechnique ou équivalent, vous avez entre 3 à 5 années minimum d’expérience en conception CFO pour les bâtiments techniques ou industriels. Vous maîtrisez les normes CFO (NF C 13-100, NF C 13-200, NF C 15-100, IEEE…). Vous avez une expertise en gestion et distribution de l’énergie pour les infrastructures critiques. Vous avez une bonne connaissance des logiciels de conception électrique (Caneco, ETAP, Dialux, AutoCAD…).  Vous êtes rigoureux, méticuleux, organisé, polyvalent, autonome. Vous avez le sens du collectif et l’envie de travailler en équipe. Vous savez bien gérer votre temps et vos priorités   Autres éléments Rémunération: 50 - 60 K€ Projets techniques de haut niveau dans un environnement agile. Avantages qualitatifs : mutuelle 100%, tickets restaurant, digital learning, abonnement sportif subventionné, afterworks, parental challenge, avantages CSE... Localisation : Paris (75) Type de contrat : CDI Possibilité de télétravail Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Agent Builder
jobs.description: Auditors sign their name to every conclusion. An agent can do the heavy lifting, but only if the auditor can see how each conclusion was reached and trace it back to its source. Agent Builder is where firms turn their own procedures into agents their whole team can run, in Alwin by DataSnipper, our agentic automation platform for audit and finance. Built well, an agent makes quality a property of the procedure, not of who happened to be staffed on the engagement. You'll own Agent Builder and the agents firms build with it. Your users are the people at firms who build agents, and the methodology and quality teams who approve them for client work. This is a technical PM role. You'll shape the harness each agent runs in: the context it sees, the tools it uses, and where a person reviews its work. You'll own the feedback loops that improve agents after release. You'll work as a peer to the Agent Builder engineering team, and with our Agent Runtime and Evals teams here in Amsterdam. About DataSnipper The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it. And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers . Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast. If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way. The problems you'll own A firm's procedure must become a harness an agent can follow, with the right context, tools and review points Models are non-deterministic, but audit work must be defensible: traceable, attributed and reviewed A firm will only rely on an agent it can test, approve and trace Reviewer feedback must make agents better, with the firm's approval and without anything reaching another client Methodology, models and standards all change. Agents in use must keep up without breaking work in progress What you'll do Own the Agent Builder strategy and roadmap, and make the trade-offs explicit Design the harness with engineering: how context is assembled, how tools are defined and called, and where a person must review Decide what builders control and what the platform sets, so agents can encode real methodology and stay consistent Build the feedback loops: turn run traces and reviewer edits into eval cases, regression tests and changes the firm approves Set the quality gates an agent must pass before release, and test every new model or methodology version before it reaches live work Report agent qual

jobs.description: About us Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 120+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next! Mission of this role Thousands of customers, most of our customer base, work with Rentman without a dedicated Customer Success Manager. They sign up, set up Rentman and get to work, but not all of them get the most out of what they pay for, and today we mostly help them when they reach out to us. We want to change that. Your job is to make sure every one of them gets the most out of what they pay for, starting with new customers in their first months. Instead of adding CSMs at the same rate as we grow, we’re building a system of signals, plays and AI agents that helps these customers adopt Rentman, stay and grow with us. However, a human touch always stays: our pooled CSMs step in at the moments where a person makes the difference. This is a new role and a new function, and you start as a team of one. You’ll build Digital CS from the start, with support from Data, Ops and AI engineering and a direct report to our Head of CX. There’s room to shape how AI agents are used in Customer Success, and a growth path towards CS or Revenue Operations. What you'll do Explore product usage, engagement, billing and support data in BigQuery to find which behaviour predicts adoption, churn or contraction. Turn those signals into trigger rules: what counts, from which threshold, at what moment and for which customer group. You build the data models behind these signals yourself, with our Data team reviewing your work. Build automated plays across email and in-app messaging in tools like HubSpot and Chameleon, starting with new customers who haven’t adopted the product yet. Every play defines when a customer goes to a pooled CSM, for example when there’s a cancellation signal or no response to the automated steps. Every play runs against a control group. Ship a small version first, measure whether the effect is real or noise, improve what works and stop what doesn’t. Shape agent specs and prompts that AI engineering builds from: tasks, rules, examples and when to hand over to a person. Define test cases and quality criteria, and check the agent’s work every week the way you would a team member’s. Work with the onboarding squad, Content & Community, Product Marketing and RevOps so plays fit their designs and don’t clash with launches or product tours, and help decide which CS tools we build on. Your first year First 3 months: you find the first signals and set baselines together with our Data team. jobs.title: Senior Process Integration Engineer
jobs.description: About Us QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors. With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! As a Senior Process Integration Engineer, you will play a key role in translating new technologies and products from development into robust, scalable, and manufacturable processes. You will work closely with Engineering, R&D, Product, Operations, and Quality teams to develop, integrate, optimise, and release processes and products into manufacturing. Your work will be essential in ensuring that new products and technologies can be reliably manufactured with the required performance, quality, and yield. What you'll be doing Lead the integration and transfer of new products, processes and technologies from R&D into manufacturing. Define and develop manufacturing process flows, process specifications and control strategies for new product introductions. Work closely with R&D and cross-functional teams to ensure new products are designed and released with manufacturability, quality and scalability in mind. Plan and execute process integration activities, including process development, qualification, validation, and release. Identify, investigate and resolve process integration issues, yield losses, and technical anomalies. Drive continuous process and yield improvements using structured problem-solving and data-driven approaches. Support the transition and scaling of manufacturing capabilities, including the implementation of new equipment, automation, and MES systems. Develop and maintain key process and quality documentation, including Process FMEAs, Control Plans, process specifications, work instructions and change control documentation. Participate in and support technical review and decision-making processes, including Change Control Boards (CCB) and Material Review Boards (MRB). Work with Operations and Manufacturing teams to establish stable, repeatable, and scalable manufacturing processes. Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior engineers as the Process Integration team grows. Your Profile 4+ years of experience in Process Integration, Process Engineering, NPI, Yield Engineering, or a related engineering role. A Master's or PhD degree in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Semiconductor Engineering, or a related technical field is preferred. Experience working in a semiconductor startup, microfabrication foundry, advanced manufacturing or other high-tech hardware environment. Strong understanding of process development, process integration, qualification, and manufacturing transfer. Experience with structured problem-solving and continuous improvement methodologies, including RCA, FMEA, SPC, DOE or similar tools. Experience in analysing process and manufacturing data to identify root causes and improve process performance and yield. Familiarity with quality and manufacturing systems, including Control Plans, non-conformance management, change control and corrective/preventive actions. Experience working in cross-functional environments involving R&D, Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality. Strong technical problem-solving skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities. Experience with semiconductor fabrication of superconducting devices or quantum technologies would be a nice to have. Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter.

Maar de échte waarde van AI zit wat ons betreft niet in de technologie zelf, maar in wat we ermee kunnen bereiken. Als onze AI & Automation Lead ontdek je waar AI het verschil kan maken. Je gaat met collega's uit verschillende afdelingen in gesprek, luistert naar hun ervaringen en uitdagingen en vertaalt ideeën en behoeften naar praktische oplossingen. Ideeën tot leven brengt: je bouwt prototypes en pilots om nieuwe toepassingen te testen. Voor grotere of complexere oplossingen werk je samen met onze developers. Tools beoordeelt: je onderzoekt bestaande en nieuwe AI-tools en adviseert over hun toegevoegde waarde, bruikbaarheid, toegankelijkheid, veiligheid en mogelijke risico's. Resultaten zichtbaar maakt: je onderzoekt wat toepassingen daadwerkelijk opleveren, bijvoorbeeld in tijdsbesparing, kwaliteit of klanttevredenheid. Vooruitkijkt: je volgt relevante AI-ontwikkelingen en helpt op basis van nieuwe inzichten onze AI-strategie verder vorm te geven. Daarbij draait het niet om zoveel mogelijk AI-tools introduceren, maar om oplossingen die daadwerkelijk iets toevoegen. Niet ieder probleem heeft AI nodig en niet ieder experiment hoeft een succes te worden. We vinden het belangrijk om samen te leren van wat wel én niet werkt. We zoeken iemand die enthousiast wordt van nieuwe technologie, maar nog veel enthousiaster van wat je ermee kunt oplossen. Je hebt ervaring met het zelfstandig begeleiden van AI-projecten van idee tot implementatie. Je bent technisch onderlegd, bouwt graag zelf oplossingen en weet wanneer het waardevol is om de kennis en expertise van anderen te betrekken. Je kunt omgaan met een rol waarin nog niet alles vastligt. Je neemt initiatief, brengt structuur aan en helpt collega's om nieuwe technologie te begrijpen en te benutten, op een manier die aansluit bij hun kennis en behoeften. jobs.title: Data Engineer (tbv Productie & ESG)
jobs.description: Heb je een passie voor data, technologie en duurzaamheid? ONE-Dyas is op zoek naar een Data Engineer om te zorgen voor de nauwkeurige verzameling, het beheer en de rapportage van productie-, koolwaterstof- en ESG-gegevens. Je zet complexe gegevens om in betrouwbare inzichten die operationele en zakelijke beslissingen ondersteunen. Wat zijn je taken? Het onderhouden en verbeteren van databases met gevalideerde productie- en ESG-gegevens. Het verzamelen en integreren van gegevens uit productiebronnen en uit geëxploiteerde en niet-geëxploiteerde activa. Het opstellen van duidelijke maand-, kwartaal- en jaarverslagen en visualisaties. Het ondersteunen van de teams Production, Engineering, HSE en ESG met gegevens ter ondersteuning van operationele en zakelijke beslissingen. HBO niveau in Techniek, Accountancy, Informatica, Milieuwetenschappen of een verwant vakgebied. Ervaring met data-engineering of ESG-rapportage, bij voorkeur binnen de energie- of olie- en gasindustrie. Kennis van databasebeheer, datavisualisatie en datagovernance. Bij voorkeur ervaring met Python, SQL of vergelijkbare tools. Sterke communicatieve en probleemoplossende vaardigheden. Een proactieve, zelfstandige en teamgerichte werkwijze met interesse in duurzaamheid. In deze functie werk je tenminste 60% van je werkweek vanuit ons kantoor in Amsterdam. Je kunt je zowel mondeling als schriftelijk goed uitdrukken in het Nederlands en Engels. Maak kennis met ONE-Dyas ONE-Dyas B.V. is het grootste particuliere exploratie- en productiebedrijf in Nederland. Als onder-nemers in de Nederlandse offshore gas- en oliesector streeft het bedrijf ernaar een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan de energietransitie, waarbij het vooroploopt op het gebied van duurzaam-heid en technologische innovatie. Het winnen van gas en olie dicht bij huis draagt bij aan de natio-nale economie, de voorzieningszekerheid en de klimaatdoelstellingen door gebruik te maken van lokale diensten, producten en knowhow, de afhankelijkheid van geïmporteerde brandstoffen te verminderen, de uitstoot te verlagen en te voldoen aan de hoogste milieunormen in de sector. Met wortels die teruggaan tot 1893 in de mijnbouw, kent ONE-Dyas een lange geschiedenis van succesvolle baanbrekende energieoplossingen. jobs.title: Software Engineer II: Autonomous Supply Chains
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Flexport:&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p>At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.&nbsp;</p> <p>The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.</p></div><h1>Applied AI Engineer, Autonomous Supply Chains</h1> <h2>About Flexport</h2> <p>Look around you. Almost everything in the room crossed an ocean to get there. Moving one container from a factory to a warehouse takes 10 to 15 companies: truckers, customs brokers, port terminals, ocean carriers, insurers, lenders and warehouses, each with its own systems, paperwork and rules. A freight forwarder runs that whole journey, so the brand that makes the goods doesn't have to.</p> <p>Most forwarders still run it on email, spreadsheets and phone calls. We call it email freight forwarding. Flexport runs it on one platform, where AI agents do the routine work and experts step in where judgment matters. We've moved $175B of goods for more than 13,000 brands across 135 countries. Our agents handle 21 million tasks a year, and up to 80% of customs work is automated.</p> <p>Global logistics is a $13 trillion industry, and even the largest forwarder earns less than 3% of global logistics outsourcing revenue. People-powered operations don't scale: to grow, you hire. Software broke that ceiling for taxis with Uber, and for payments with Adyen and Stripe. Freight is next.</p> <p>Amsterdam is one of Flexport's six engineering hubs, alongside San Francisco, Seattle, Chicago, Shanghai and Shenzhen. We own four domains end to end: Customs Technology, Autonomous Supply Chains (Applied AI), Platform and Security. See what we build at <a href="https://amsterdam-engineering.flexport.com">amsterdam-engineering.flexport.com</a>.</p> <h2>The team: Autonomous Supply Chains</h2> <p>Logistics is famously hard to automate, because the happy path rarely happens. One customer won't take deliveries on a Tuesday. Another wants invoices only on Fridays, with some lines merged and others renamed. Until recently, people handled all of that by hand. Now operators use Forge, the agentic platform we build, to automate their own work: catching anomalies, routing exceptions, escalating stuck containers and adjusting invoices to each customer. Forge remembers every customer's rules and learns from every workflow run, so it gets smarter every day.</p> <p>Autonomous Supply Chains is our Applied AI team: small, senior and reporting to the VP of Engineering. Self-driving cars are rated from level 0 to level 5. Most of the freight industry still runs at level 0: people emailing spreadsheets. jobs.title: Senior Microsoft 365 Copilot & Purview Consultant

jobs.title: Lead Data Engineer
jobs.description: Who are we? At UpGuard , we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process around 10 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk. We build the Risk Operations Center, the AI platform where lean security teams run cyber risk end to end. It combines security ratings, threat intelligence and AI agents to give teams one view of risk across their vendors, attack surface and workforce. We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale. Where does this role fit in? UpGuard has recently replatformed its analytics stack onto a greenfield foundation built on BigQuery, dbt, infrastructure as code in OpenTofu, CI/CD through GitHub, and a governed semantic layer that both people and AI agents query. We are seeking an experienced data engineer to help take that platform to the next level. Reporting to the Director of Data Engineering, this role is the strong technical lead within the data engineering team. You will work under the Director's guidance to evolve the platform and raise its engineering standards, and you will set the example for how the team builds, reviews and ships. The platform has a broad contributor and consumer base. Analysts, data scientists and business teams build on it, query it and increasingly reach it through AI agents. Keeping those stakeholders well served and satisfied is a central measure of success in this role. What will you do? Technical Leadership: Act as the senior technical voice within the data engineering team by guiding design decisions, reviewing code, mentoring engineers and contributing to the platform roadmap set by the team. Platform Evolution: Help take UpGuard's recently built GCP data platform to its next stage, proposing and delivering improvements to scale, reliability, performance, cost and AI workflows. Engineering Standards & CI/CD: Raise engineering standards across the platform, and build and maintain the CI/CD pipelines, PR checks, BI model validation and developer environments that keep changes safe to ship. Stakeholder Engagement & Satisfaction: Treat the analysts, data scientists, and business teams who depend on the platform as customers. Understand their needs, scope and prioritise requests with them, set clear expectations, follow through on commitments, and track how well the platform serves them. Contributor Enablement: Support the growing group of analysts, data scientists and business users who contribute dbt code, through onboarding, documentation, AI agents, review practices and developer tooling that make good contributions the easy path. Data Integration: Design, build and maintain reliable pipelines that bring data from internal systems (CRM, billing, support, marketing automation and product events) and third-party sources into BigQuery using managed connectors, event streams and vendor APIs, and write data back to operational systems where needed. Platform Operations & Maintenance: Manage infrastructure as code in OpenTofu, run containerised workloads on Docker and Kubernetes, maintain build scheduling and deployment pipelines, and keep the platform monitored, patched and well documented. dbt Development: Author and review dbt models across the staging, source-level and business-level layers, and uphold the team's conventions for modelling, grain testing and documentation. Data Quality: Implement and maintain data tests, source freshness checks, observability and alerting, and take part in incident response so that problems are caught and fixed before stakeholders find them.
